verse.web: One of the multitude said to him, “Teacher, tell my brother to divide the inheritance with me.” But he said to him, “Man, who made me a judge or an arbitrator over you?” He said to them, “Beware!
verse.es: Entonces le dijo uno del auditorio: Maestro, dile a mi hermano que me dé la parte que me toca de la herencia. Pero Jesús le respondió: ¡Oh hombre! ¿quién me ha constituido a mí juez, o repartidor entre vosotros.

verse.en: Let your loins be girt and lamps burning in your hands. And you yourselves like to men who wait for their lord, when he shall return from the wedding; that when he cometh and knocketh, they may open to him immediately.
verse.web: “Let your waist be dressed and your lamps burning. Be like men watching for their lord when he returns from the wedding feast, that when he comes and knocks, they may immediately open to him.
verse.es: Estad con vuestras ropas ceñidas a la cintura, y tened en vuestras manos las luces ya encendidas prontos a servir a vuestro Señor, sed semejantes a los criados que aguardan a su amo cuando vuelve de las bodas…

verse.en: But this know ye, that if the householder did know at what hour the thief would come, he would surely watch and would not suffer his house to be broken open.
verse.web: But know this, that if the master of the house had known in what hour the thief was coming, he would have watched and not allowed his house to be broken into.
verse.es: Tened esto por cierto, que si el padre de familias supiera a qué hora había de venir el ladrón, estaría ciertamente velando, y no dejaría que le horadasen y forzasen su casa.

verse.en: I am come to cast fire on the earth. And what will I, but that it be kindled? And I have a baptism wherewith I am to be baptized. And how am I straitened until it be accomplished?
verse.web: “I came to throw fire on the earth. I wish it were already kindled. But I have a baptism to be baptized with, and how distressed I am until it is accomplished! Do you think that I have come to give peace on the earth?
verse.es: Yo he venido a poner fuego en la tierra, ¿y qué he de querer sino que arda? Con un bautismo de sangre tengo de ser yo bautizado: ¡oh y cómo traigo en prensa el corazón, mientras que no lo veo cumplido!

verse.en: And he said also to the multitudes: When you see a cloud rising from the west, presently you say: A shower is coming. And so it happeneth. And when ye see the south wind blow, you say: There will be heat.
verse.web: He said to the multitudes also, “When you see a cloud rising from the west, immediately you say, ‘A shower is coming,’ and so it happens.
verse.es: Decía también al pueblo: En viendo una nube que se levanta del Ocaso, al instante decís: Tempestad tenemos; y así sucede. Y cuando veis que sopla el aire de Mediodía, decís: Hará calor; y le hace. ¡Hipócritas!

verse.en: And there were present, at that very time, some that told him of the Galileans, whose blood Pilate had mingled with their sacrifices.
verse.web: Now there were some present at the same time who told him about the Galileans whose blood Pilate had mixed with their sacrifices.
verse.es: En este mismo tiempo vinieron algunos, y contaron a Jesús lo que había sucedido a unos galileos, cuya sangre mezcló Pilato con la de los sacrificios que ellos ofrecían.

verse.en: But the Pharisees, hearing that he had silenced the Sadducees, came together. And one of them, a doctor of the law, asked him, tempting him: Master, which is the great commandment in the law?
verse.web: But the Pharisees, when they heard that he had silenced the Sadducees, gathered themselves together. One of them, a lawyer, asked him a question, testing him. “Teacher, which is the greatest commandment in the law?”
verse.es: Pero los Fariseos, informados de que había tapado la boca a los sadduceos, se mancomunaron; y uno de ellos, doctor de la ley, le preguntó para tentarle: Maestro, ¿cuál es el mandamiento principal de la Ley?

verse.en: And he was teaching in their synagogue on their sabbath. And behold there was a woman who had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years. And she was bowed together: neither could she look upwards at all.
verse.web: He was teaching in one of the synagogues on the Sabbath day. Behold, there was a woman who had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years. She was bent over and could in no way straighten herself up.
verse.es: Enseñando Jesús un día de sábado en la synagoga, he aquí que Vino allí una muger, que por espacio de diez y ocho años padecía una enfermedad causada de un maligno espíritu; y andaba encorvada…

verse.en: He said therefore: To what is the kingdom of God like, and whereunto shall I resemble it?
verse.web: He said, “What is God’s Kingdom like? To what shall I compare it? It is like a grain of mustard seed which a man took and put in his own garden.
verse.es: Decía también Jesús: ¿A qué cosa es semejante el reino de Dios, o con qué podré compararle?

verse.en: And it came to pass in those days, that he went out into a mountain to pray: and he passed the whole night in the prayer of God.
verse.web: In these days, he went out to the mountain to pray, and he continued all night in prayer to God.
verse.es: Por este tiempo se retiró a orar en un monte, y pasó toda la noche haciendo oración a Dios.

verse.en: The same day, there came some of the Pharisees, saying to him: Depart, and get thee hence, for Herod hath a mind to kill thee.
verse.web: On that same day, some Pharisees came, saying to him, “Get out of here and go away, for Herod wants to kill you.”
verse.es: En el mismo día vinieron algunos Fariseos a decirle: Sal de aquí, y retírate a otra parte, porque Herodes quiere matarte.

verse.en: And it came to pass, when Jesus went into the house of one of the chief of the Pharisees, on the sabbath day, to eat bread, that they watched him. And behold, there was a certain man before him that had the dropsy.
verse.web: When he went into the house of one of the rulers of the Pharisees on a Sabbath to eat bread, they were watching him. Behold, a certain man who had dropsy was in front of him.
verse.es: Y sucedió que habiendo entrado Jesús en casa de uno de los principales Fariseos a comer en un día de sábado, le estaban estos acechando. Y he aquí que se puso delante de él un hombre hidrópico.

verse.en: And it came to pass, when Jesus went into the house of one of the chief of the Pharisees, on the sabbath day, to eat bread, that they watched him.
verse.web: When he went into the house of one of the rulers of the Pharisees on a Sabbath to eat bread, they were watching him.
verse.es: Y sucedió que habiendo entrado Jesús en casa de uno de los principales Fariseos a comer en un día de sábado, le estaban estos acechando.

verse.en: And seeing the multitudes, he went up into a mountain, and when he was set down, his disciples came unto him.
verse.web: Seeing the multitudes, he went up onto the mountain. When he had sat down, his disciples came to him. He opened his mouth and taught them, saying, “Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.
verse.es: Mas viendo Jesús a todo este gentío, se subió a un monte, donde habiéndose sentado, se le acercaron sus discípulos, y abriendo su boca divina, los adoctrinaba diciendo: Bienaventurados los pobres de espíritu…

celebration.en: The Commemoration of All the Faithful Departed (All Souls' Day)
celebration.es: Conmemoración de todos los fieles difuntos

verse.en: When one of them that sat at table with him had heard these things, he said to him: Blessed is he that shall eat bread in the kingdom of God. But he said to him: A certain man made a great supper and invited many.
verse.web: When one of those who sat at the table with him heard these things, he said to him, “Blessed is he who will feast in God’s Kingdom!” But he said to him, “A certain man made a great supper, and he invited many people.
verse.es: Habiendo oído esto uno de los convidados, le dijo: ¡Oh bienaventurado aquel que tendrá parte en el convite del reino de Dios! Mas Jesús le respondió: Un hombre dispuso una gran cena, y convidó a mucha gente.

verse.en: And there went great multitudes with him.
verse.web: Now great multitudes were going with him.
verse.es: Sucedió que yendo con Jesús gran multitud de gentes, vuelto a ellas les dijo: Si alguno de los que me siguen, no aborrece, o no ama menos que a mí, a su padre y madre, y a la muger, y a los hijos…

verse.en: Now the publicans and sinners drew near unto him to hear him. And the Pharisees and the scribes murmured, saying: This man receiveth sinners and eateth with them.
verse.web: Now all the tax collectors and sinners were coming close to him to hear him. The Pharisees and the scribes murmured, saying, “This man welcomes sinners, and eats with them.”
verse.es: Solían los publicanos, y pecadores acercarse a Jesús para oírle. Y los Fariseos y Escribas murmuraban de eso diciendo: Mirad cómo se familiariza con los pecadores, y come con ellos.

verse.en: And he said also to his disciples: There was a certain rich man who had a steward: and the same was accused unto him, that he had wasted his goods. And he called him and said to him: How is it that I hear this of thee?
verse.web: He also said to his disciples, “There was a certain rich man who had a manager. An accusation was made to him that this man was wasting his possessions.
verse.es: Decía también Jesús a sus discípulos: Érase un hombre rico, que tenía un mayordomo, del cual por la voz común vino a entender que le había disipado sus bienes. Llamole pues, y díjole: ¿Qué es esto que oigo de ti?

verse.en: And I say to you: Make unto you friends of the mammon of iniquity: that when you shall fail, they may receive you into everlasting dwellings.
verse.web: I tell you, make for yourselves friends by means of unrighteous mammon, so that when you fail, they may receive you into the eternal tents. He who is faithful in a very little is faithful also in much.
verse.es: Así os digo yo a vosotros: Grangeaos amigos con las riquezas, manantial de iniquidad, para que, cuando falleciereis, seáis recibidos en las moradas eternas.

verse.en: Then shall the kingdom of heaven be like to ten virgins, who taking their lamps went out to meet the bridegroom and the bride. And five of them were foolish and five wise.
verse.web: “Then the Kingdom of Heaven will be like ten virgins who took their lamps and went out to meet the bridegroom. Five of them were foolish, and five were wise.
verse.es: Entonces el reino de los cielos será semejante a diez vírgenes, que tomando sus lámparas, salieron a recibir al esposo y a la esposa.

celebration.en: The Dedication of the Lateran Basilica
celebration.es: Dedicación de la Basílica de Letrán

verse.en: And the pasch of the Jews was at hand: and Jesus went up to Jerusalem. And he found in the temple them that sold oxen and sheep and doves, and the changers of money sitting.
verse.web: The Passover of the Jews was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem. He found in the temple those who sold oxen, sheep, and doves, and the changers of money sitting.
verse.es: Estaba ya cerca la Pascua de los judíos, y Jesús subió a Jerusalem; y encontrando en el Templo gentes que vendían bueyes, y ovejas, y palomas, y cambistas sentados en sus mesas…

celebration.en: Saint Leo the Great, Pope and Doctor of the Church
celebration.es: San León Magno, Papa y doctor de la Iglesia

verse.en: But which of you, having a servant ploughing or feeding cattle, will say to him, when he is come from the field: Immediately go. Sit down to meat.
verse.web: But who is there among you, having a servant plowing or keeping sheep, that will say when he comes in from the field, ‘Come immediately and sit down at the table’?
verse.es: ¿Quién hay entre vosotros que teniendo un criado de labranza, o pastor, luego que vuelve del campo le diga: Ven, ponte a la mesa; y que al contrario no le diga: Disponme la cena, cíñete…

verse.en: And it came to pass, as he was going to Jerusalem, he passed through the midst of Samaria and Galilee. And as he entered into a certain town, there met him ten men that were lepers, who stood afar off.
verse.web: As he was on his way to Jerusalem, he was passing along the borders of Samaria and Galilee. As he entered into a certain village, ten men who were lepers met him, who stood at a distance.
verse.es: Caminando Jesús acia Jerusalem, atravesaba las provincias de Samaria y de Galilea.

verse.en: And being asked by the Pharisees when the kingdom of God should come, he answered them and said: The kingdom of God cometh not with observation. Neither shall they say: Behold here, or behold there.
verse.web: Being asked by the Pharisees when God’s Kingdom would come, he answered them, “God’s Kingdom doesn’t come with observation; neither will they say, ‘Look, here!’ or, ‘Look, there!’
verse.es: Preguntado por los Fariseos: ¿Cuándo vendrá el reino de Dios? les dio por respuesta: El reino de Dios no ha de venir con muestras de aparato; ni se dirá: Vele aquí, o vele allí.

verse.en: And as it came to pass in the days of Noe, so shall it be also in the days of the Son of man.
verse.web: As it was in the days of Noah, even so it will also be in the days of the Son of Man.
verse.es: Lo que acaeció en el tiempo de Noé, igualmente acaecerá en el día del Hijo del hombre.

verse.en: And he spoke also a parable to them, that we ought always to pray and not to faint, Saying: There was a judge in a certain city, who feared not God nor regarded man.
verse.web: He also spoke a parable to them that they must always pray and not give up, saying, “There was a judge in a certain city who didn’t fear God and didn’t respect man.
verse.es: Propúsoles también esta parábola, para hacer ver que conviene orar perseverantemente y no desfallecer, diciendo: En cierta ciudad había un juez, que ni tenía temor de Dios, ni respeto a hombre alguno.

verse.en: For even as a man going into a far country called his servants and delivered to them his goods; And to one he gave five talents, and to another two, and to another one, to every one according to his proper ability…
verse.web: “For it is like a man going into another country, who called his own servants and entrusted his goods to them. To one he gave five talents, to another two, to another one, to each according to his own ability.
verse.es: Porque el Señor obrará como un hombre que yéndose a lejas tierras, convocó a sus criados, y les entregó sus bienes, dando al uno cinco talentos, a otro dos, y uno solo a otro, a cada uno según su capacidad…

verse.en: Now it came to pass, when he drew nigh to Jericho, that a certain blind man sat by the way side, begging. And when he heard the multitude passing by, he asked what this meant.
verse.web: As he came near Jericho, a certain blind man sat by the road, begging. Hearing a multitude going by, he asked what this meant. They told him that Jesus of Nazareth was passing by.
verse.es: Y al acercarse a Jerichô, estaba un ciego sentado a la orilla del camino, pidiendo limosna. Y sintiendo el tropel de la gente que pasaba, preguntó qué novedad era aquella.

verse.en: And entering he walked through Jericho. And behold, there was a man named Zacheus, who was the chief of the publicans: and he was rich.
verse.web: He entered and was passing through Jericho. There was a man named Zacchaeus. He was a chief tax collector, and he was rich. He was trying to see who Jesus was, and couldn’t because of the crowd, because he was short.
verse.es: Habiendo Jesús entrado en Jerichô, atravesaba por la ciudad.

verse.en: As they were hearing these things, he added and spoke a parable, because he was nigh to Jerusalem and because they thought that the kingdom of God should immediately be manifested.
verse.web: As they heard these things, he went on and told a parable, because he was near Jerusalem, and they supposed that God’s Kingdom would be revealed immediately.
verse.es: Mientras escuchaban estas cosas los circunstantes, añadió una parábola, atento a que se hallaba vecino a Jerusalem, y las gentes creían que luego se había de manifestar el reino de Dios.

verse.en: And when he drew near, seeing the city, he wept over it, saying: If thou also hadst known, and that in this thy day, the things that are to thy peace: but now they are hidden from thy eyes.
verse.web: When he came near, he saw the city and wept over it, saying, “If you, even you, had known today the things which belong to your peace! But now, they are hidden from your eyes.
verse.es: Al llegar cerca de Jerusalem, poniéndose a mirar esta ciudad, derramó lágrimas sobre ella, diciendo: ¡Ah!

verse.en: And entering into the temple, he began to cast out them that sold therein and them that bought. Saying to them: It is written: My house is the house of prayer. But you have made it a den of thieves.
verse.web: He entered into the temple and began to drive out those who bought and sold in it, saying to them, “It is written, ‘My house is a house of prayer,’ but you have made it a ‘den of robbers’!”
verse.es: Y habiendo entrado en el Templo, comenzó a echar fuera a los que vendían y compraban en él, diciéndoles: Escrito está: Mi Casa es casa de oración; mas vosotros la tenéis hecha una cueva de ladrones.

celebration.en: The Presentation of the Blessed Virgin Mary
celebration.es: Presentación de la Bienaventurada Virgen María

verse.en: And there came to him some of the Sadducees, who deny that there is any resurrection: and they asked him, Saying: Master, Moses wrote unto us: If any man’s brother die, having a wife, and he leave no children…
verse.web: Some of the Sadducees came to him, those who deny that there is a resurrection.
verse.es: Llegaron después algunos de los sadduceos, los cuales niegan la resurrección, y le propusieron este caso, con el cual pensaban enredarle: Maestro, Moysés nos dejó escrito que si el hermano de alguno, estando casado…

celebration.en: Our Lord Jesus Christ, King of the Universe
celebration.es: Nuestro Señor Jesucristo, Rey del Universo

verse.en: And when the Son of man shall come in his majesty, and all the angels with him, then shall he sit upon the seat of his majesty.
verse.web: “But when the Son of Man comes in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then he will sit on the throne of his glory.
verse.es: Cuando venga pues el Hijo del hombre con toda su magestad, y acompañado de todos sus ángeles, sentarse ha entonces en el trono de su gloria; y hará comparecer delante de el a todas las naciones…

verse.en: And looking on, he saw the rich men cast their gifts into the treasury. And he saw also a certain poor widow casting in two brass mites.
verse.web: He looked up and saw the rich people who were putting their gifts into the treasury. He saw a certain poor widow casting in two small brass coins.
verse.es: Estando un día Jesús mirando acia el gazophylacio o cepo del Templo, vio a varios ricos que iban echando en él sus ofrendas. Y vio asimismo a una pobrecita viuda, la cual echaba dos blancas o pequeñas monedas.

celebration.en: Saint Andrew Dũng-Lạc, Priest, and Companions, Martyrs
celebration.es: Santos Andrés Dũng-Lạc, presbítero, y compañeros, mártires

verse.en: And some saying of the temple that it was adorned with goodly stones and gifts, he said: These things which you see, the days will come in which there shall not be left a stone upon a stone that shall not be thrown down.
verse.web: As some were talking about the temple and how it was decorated with beautiful stones and gifts, he said, “As for these things which you see…
verse.es: Como algunos de sus discípulos dijesen del Templo, que estaba fabricado de hermosas piedras, y adornado de ricos dones, replicó: Días vendrán en que todo esto que veis…

verse.en: But before all these things, they will lay their hands on you and persecute you, delivering you up to the synagogues and into prisons, dragging you before kings and governors, for my name’s sake.
verse.web: But before all these things, they will lay their hands on you and will persecute you, delivering you up to synagogues and prisons, bringing you before kings and governors for my name’s sake.
verse.es: Pero antes que sucedan todas estas cosas, se apoderarán de vosotros, y os perseguirán, y os entregarán a las synagogas, y meterán en las cárceles, y os llevarán por fuerza a el tribunal de los reyes y gobernadores…

verse.en: And when you shall see Jerusalem compassed about with an army, then know that the desolation thereof is at hand.
verse.web: “But when you see Jerusalem surrounded by armies, then know that its desolation is at hand. Then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains. Let those who are in the middle of her depart.
verse.es: Mas por lo que toca a la ruina de este pueblo, cuando viereis a Jerusalem estar cercada por un ejército, entonces tened por cierto que su desolación esta cerca: en aquella hora los que se hallan en Judea…

verse.en: And he spoke to them a similitude.
verse.web: He told them a parable. “See the fig tree and all the trees. When they are already budding, you see it and know by your own selves that the summer is already near.
verse.es: Y propúsoles esta comparación: Reparad en la higuera, y en los demás árboles: cuando ya empiezan a brotar de sí el fruto, conocéis que está cerca el verano.

verse.en: And take heed to yourselves, lest perhaps your hearts be overcharged with surfeiting and drunkenness and the cares of this life: and that day come upon you suddenly.
verse.web: “So be careful, or your hearts will be loaded down with carousing, drunkenness, and cares of this life, and that day will come on you suddenly.
verse.es: Velad pues sobre vosotros mismos, no suceda que se ofusquen vuestros corazones o entendimientos con la glotonería, y embriaguez, y los cuidados de esta vida, y os sobrecoja de repente aquel día…

verse.en: Take ye heed, watch and pray. For ye know not when the time is. Even as a man who, going into a far country, left his house and gave authority to his servants over every work and commanded the porter to watch.
verse.web: Watch, keep alert, and pray; for you don’t know when the time is.
verse.es: Estad pues alerta, velad, y orad, ya que no sabéis cuándo será el tiempo.

verse.en: And Jesus walking by the sea of Galilee, saw two brethren, Simon who is called Peter, and Andrew his brother, casting a net into the sea (for they were fishers).
verse.web: Walking by the sea of Galilee, he saw two brothers: Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew, his brother, casting a net into the sea; for they were fishermen.
verse.es: Caminando un día Jesús por la ribera del mar de Galilea, vio a dos hermanos, Simón, llamado Pedro, y Andrés su hermano, echando la red en el mar, (pues eran pescadores) y les dijo: Seguidme a mí…

verse.en: In that same hour, he rejoiced in the Holy Ghost and said: I confess to thee, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because thou hast hidden these things from the wise and prudent and hast revealed them to little ones.
verse.web: In that same hour, Jesus rejoiced in the Holy Spirit, and said, “I thank you, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that you have hidden these things from the wise and understanding, and revealed them to little children.
verse.es: En aquel mismo punto Jesús manifestó un extraordinario gozo, al impulso del Espíritu santo, y dijo: Yo te alabo, Padre mío, señor del cielo y de la tierra…

verse.en: And when Jesus had passed away from thence, he came nigh the sea of Galilee: and going up into a mountain, he sat there.
verse.web: Jesus departed from there and came near to the sea of Galilee; and he went up on the mountain and sat there.
verse.es: De allí pasó Jesús a la ribera del mar de Galilea; y subiendo a un monte, sentose en él.

verse.en: Not every one that saith to me, Lord, Lord, shall enter into the kingdom of heaven: but he that doth the will of my Father who is in heaven, he shall enter into the kingdom of heaven.
verse.web: “Not everyone who says to me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven, but he who does the will of my Father who is in heaven.
verse.es: No todo aquel que me dice: ¡Oh Señor, Señor! entrará por eso en el reino de los cielos; sino el que hace la voluntad de mi Padre celestial, ese es el que entrará en el reino de los cielos.

verse.en: And as Jesus passed from thence, there followed him two blind men crying out and saying, Have mercy on us, O Son of David. And when he was come to the house, the blind men came to him.
verse.web: As Jesus passed by from there, two blind men followed him, calling out and saying, “Have mercy on us, son of David!” When he had come into the house, the blind men came to him.
verse.es: Partiendo Jesús de aquel lugar, le siguieron dos ciegos, gritando, y diciendo: Hijo de David, ten compasión de nosotros. Luego que llegó a casa, se le presentaron los ciegos.

verse.en: And Jesus went about all the cities and towns, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing every disease, and every infirmity.
verse.web: Jesus went about all the cities and the villages, teaching in their synagogues and preaching the Good News of the Kingdom, and healing every disease and every sickness among the people.
verse.es: Y Jesús iba recorriendo todas las ciudades y villas, enseñando en sus synagogas, y predicando el Evangelio del reino de Dios, y curando toda dolencia, y toda enfermedad.

verse.en: The beginning of the gospel of Jesus Christ, the Son of God. As it is written in Isaias the prophet: Behold I send my angel before thy face, who shall prepare the way before thee.
verse.web: The beginning of the Good News of Jesus Christ, the Son of God.
verse.es: Principio del Evangelio de Jesu-Christo, Hijo de Dios.

celebration.en: Saint Ambrose, Bishop and Doctor of the Church
celebration.es: San Ambrosio, obispo y doctor de la Iglesia

verse.en: And it came to pass on a certain day, as he sat teaching, that there were also Pharisees and doctors of the law sitting by, that were come out of every town of Galilee and Judea and Jerusalem…
verse.web: On one of those days, he was teaching; and there were Pharisees and teachers of the law sitting by who had come out of every village of Galilee, Judea, and Jerusalem. The power of the Lord was with him to heal them.
verse.es: Estaba Jesús un día sentado enseñando, y estaban asimismo sentados allí varios Fariseos y doctores de la ley, que habían venido de todos los lugares de Galilea y de Judea, y de la ciudad de Jerusalem para espiarle…

celebration.en: The Immaculate Conception of the Blessed Virgin Mary
celebration.es: Inmaculada Concepción de la Bienaventurada Virgen María

verse.en: And in the sixth month, the angel Gabriel was sent from God into a city of Galilee, called Nazareth, To a virgin espoused to a man whose name was Joseph, of the house of David: and the virgin’s name was Mary.
verse.web: Now in the sixth month, the angel Gabriel was sent from God to a city of Galilee named Nazareth, to a virgin pledged to be married to a man whose name was Joseph, of David’s house. The virgin’s name was Mary.
verse.es: Estando ya Elisabeth en su sexto mes, envió Dios al ángel Gabriel a Nazareth, ciudad de Galilea, a una virgen desposada con cierto varón de la casa de David, llamado Joseph, y el nombre de la virgen era María.

verse.en: Come to me all you that labor and are burdened, and I will refresh you. Take up my yoke upon you, and learn of me, because I am meek, and humble of heart: And you shall find rest to your souls.
verse.web: “Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest. Take my yoke upon you and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart; and you will find rest for your souls.
verse.es: Venid a mí todos los que andáis agobiados con trabajos y cargas, que yo os aliviaré. Tomad mi yugo sobre vosotros, y aprended de mí, que soy manso y humilde de corazón; y hallaréis el reposo para vuestras almas.

verse.en: Amen I say to you, there hath not risen among them that are born of women a greater than John the Baptist: yet he that is the lesser in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he.
verse.web: Most certainly I tell you, among those who are born of women there has not arisen anyone greater than John the Baptizer; yet he who is least in the Kingdom of Heaven is greater than he.
verse.es: En verdad os digo, que no ha salido a luz entre los hijos de mugeres alguno mayor que Juan Bautista: si bien el que es menor en el reino de los cielos, es superior a el.

verse.en: But whereunto shall I esteem this generation to be like? It is like to children sitting in the market place.
verse.web: “But to what shall I compare this generation? It is like children sitting in the marketplaces, who call to their companions and say, ‘We played the flute for you, and you didn’t dance.
verse.es: Mas ¿a quién compararé yo esta raza de hombres?

verse.en: And in the sixth month, the angel Gabriel was sent from God into a city of Galilee, called Nazareth, To a virgin espoused to a man whose name was Joseph, of the house of David: and the virgin’s name was Mary.
verse.web: Now in the sixth month, the angel Gabriel was sent from God to a city of Galilee named Nazareth, to a virgin pledged to be married to a man whose name was Joseph, of David’s house. The virgin’s name was Mary.
verse.es: Estando ya Elisabeth en su sexto mes, envió Dios al ángel Gabriel a Nazareth, ciudad de Galilea, a una virgen desposada con cierto varón de la casa de David, llamado Joseph, y el nombre de la virgen era María.

verse.en: There was a man sent from God, whose name was John. This man came for a witness, to give testimony of the light, that all men might believe through him. He was not the light, but was to give testimony of the light.
verse.web: There came a man sent from God, whose name was John. The same came as a witness, that he might testify about the light, that all might believe through him.
verse.es: Hubo un hombre enviado de Dios, que se llamaba Juan.

celebration.en: Saint John of the Cross, Priest and Doctor of the Church
celebration.es: San Juan de la Cruz, presbítero y doctor de la Iglesia

verse.en: And when he was come into the temple, there came to him, as he was teaching, the chief priests and ancients of the people, saying: By what authority dost thou these things? And who hath given thee this authority?
verse.web: When he had come into the temple, the chief priests and the elders of the people came to him as he was teaching, and said, “By what authority do you do these things? Who gave you this authority?”
verse.es: Llegado al Templo, se acercaron a él, cuando estaba ya enseñando, los príncipes de los sacerdotes, y los Ancianos o senadores del pueblo, y le preguntaron: ¿Con qué autoridad haces estas cosas?

verse.en: But what think you? A certain man had two sons: and coming to the first, he said: Son, go work to day in my vineyard. And he answering, said: I will not. But afterwards, being moved with repentance, he went.
verse.web: But what do you think? A man had two sons, and he came to the first, and said, ‘Son, go work today in my vineyard.’ He answered, ‘I will not,’ but afterward he changed his mind, and went.
verse.es: ¿Y qué os parece de lo que voy a decir? Un hombre tenía dos hijos, y llamando al primero, le dijo: Hijo, ve hoy a trabajar en mi viña. Y él respondió: No quiero. Pero después, arrepentido fue.

verse.en: And John’s disciples told him of all these things. And John called to him two of his disciples and sent them to Jesus, saying: Art thou he that art to come? Or look we for another?
verse.web: The disciples of John told him about all these things. John, calling to himself two of his disciples, sent them to Jesus, saying, “Are you the one who is coming, or should we look for another?”
verse.es: De todas estas cosas informaron a Juan Sus discípulos. Y Juan llamando a dos de ellos, enviolos a Jesús para que le hiciesen esta pregunta: ¿Eres tú aquel que ha de venir a salvar al mundo, o debemos esperar a otro?

verse.en: The book of the generation of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham: Abraham begot Isaac. And Isaac begot Jacob. And Jacob begot Judas and his brethren. And Judas begot Phares and Zara of Thamar.
verse.web: The book of the genealogy of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham. Abraham became the father of Isaac. Isaac became the father of Jacob. Jacob became the father of Judah and his brothers.
verse.es: Genealogía de Jesu-Christo, hijo de David, hijo de Abraham. Abraham engendró a Isaac. Isaac engendró a Jacob. Jacob engendró a Judas, y a sus hermanos. Judas engendró de Thamar a Pharés y a Zara. Pharés engendró a Esrón.

verse.en: Now the generation of Christ was in this wise. When as his mother Mary was espoused to Joseph, before they came together, she was found with child, of the Holy Ghost.
verse.web: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was like this: After his mother, Mary, was engaged to Joseph, before they came together, she was found pregnant by the Holy Spirit.
verse.es: Pero el nacimiento de Christo fue de esta manera: Estando desposada su madre María con Joseph, sin que antes hubiesen estado juntos, se halló que había concebido en su seno por obra del Espíritu santo.

verse.en: There was in the days of Herod, the king of Judea, a certain priest named Zachary, of the course of Abia: and his wife was of the daughters of Aaron, and her name Elizabeth.
verse.web: There was in the days of Herod, the king of Judea, a certain priest named Zacharias, of the priestly division of Abijah. He had a wife of the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elizabeth.
verse.es: Siendo Herodes rey de Judea, hubo un sacerdote llamado Zachàrias, de la familia sacerdotal de Abia, una de aquellas que servían por turno en el Templo, cuya muger, llamada Elisabeth, era igualmente del linage de Aarón.

verse.en: And in the sixth month, the angel Gabriel was sent from God into a city of Galilee, called Nazareth, To a virgin espoused to a man whose name was Joseph, of the house of David: and the virgin’s name was Mary.
verse.web: Now in the sixth month, the angel Gabriel was sent from God to a city of Galilee named Nazareth, to a virgin pledged to be married to a man whose name was Joseph, of David’s house. The virgin’s name was Mary.
verse.es: Estando ya Elisabeth en su sexto mes, envió Dios al ángel Gabriel a Nazareth, ciudad de Galilea, a una virgen desposada con cierto varón de la casa de David, llamado Joseph, y el nombre de la virgen era María.

verse.en: And Mary rising up in those days, went into the hill country with haste into a city of Juda. And she entered into the house of Zachary and saluted Elizabeth.
verse.web: Mary arose in those days and went into the hill country with haste, into a city of Judah, and entered into the house of Zacharias and greeted Elizabeth.
verse.es: Por aquellos días partió María, y se fue apresuradamente a las montañas de Judea a una ciudad de la tribu de Judá; y habiendo entrado en la casa de Zachârías, saludó a Elisabeth.

verse.en: And Mary said: My soul doth magnify the Lord. And my spirit hath rejoiced in God my Saviour. Because he hath regarded the humility of his handmaid: for behold from henceforth all generations shall call me blessed.
verse.web: Mary said, “My soul magnifies the Lord. My spirit has rejoiced in God my Savior, for he has looked at the humble state of his servant. For behold, from now on, all generations will call me blessed.
verse.es: Entonces María dijo: Mi alma glorifica al Señor; y mi espíritu está trasportado de gozo en el Dios salvador mío.

verse.en: Now Elizabeth’s full time of being delivered was come: and she brought forth a son. And her neighbors and kinsfolks heard that the Lord had shewed his great mercy towards her: and they congratulated with her.
verse.web: Now the time that Elizabeth should give birth was fulfilled, and she gave birth to a son. Her neighbors and her relatives heard that the Lord had magnified his mercy toward her, and they rejoiced with her.
verse.es: Entre tanto le llegó a Elisabeth el tiempo de su alumbramiento, y dio a luz un hijo. Supieron sus vecinos y parientes la gran misericordia que Dios le había hecho, y se congratulaban con ella.

verse.en: And Zachary his father was filled with the Holy Ghost. And he prophesied, saying: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel: because he hath visited and wrought the redemption of his people.
verse.web: His father Zacharias was filled with the Holy Spirit, and prophesied, saying, “Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, for he has visited and redeemed his people…
verse.es: Además de que Zachârías su padre quedó lleno del Espíritu santo, y profetizó, diciendo: Bendito sea el Señor Dios de Israel, porque ha visitado, y redimido a su pueblo…

verse.en: In the beginning was the Word: and the Word was with God: and the Word was God. The same was in the beginning with God. All things were made by him: and without him was made nothing that was made.
verse.web: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God. The same was in the beginning with God. All things were made through him. Without him, nothing was made that has been made.
verse.es: En el principio era ya el Verbo, y el Verbo estaba en Dios, y el Verbo era Dios. Él estaba en el principio en Dios.

verse.en: But beware of men. For they will deliver you up in councils, and they will scourge you in their synagogues.
verse.web: But beware of men, for they will deliver you up to councils, and in their synagogues they will scourge you. Yes, and you will be brought before governors and kings for my sake, for a testimony to them and to the nations.
verse.es: Recataos empero de los tales hombres.

celebration.en: The Holy Family of Jesus, Mary and Joseph
celebration.es: Sagrada Familia de Jesús, María y José

verse.en: And after the days of her purification, according to the law of Moses, were accomplished, they carried him to Jerusalem, to present him to the Lord: As it is written in the law of the Lord…
verse.web: When the days of their purification according to the law of Moses were fulfilled, they brought him up to Jerusalem to present him to the Lord (as it is written in the law of the Lord…
verse.es: Cumplido asimismo el tiempo de la purificación de la madre, según la ley de Moysés, llevaron al niño a Jerusalem, para presentarle al Señor, como está escrito en la Ley del Señor: Todo varón que nazca el primero…

verse.en: And after they were departed, behold an angel of the Lord appeared in sleep to Joseph, saying: Arise, and take the child and his mother, and fly into Egypt: and be there until I shall tell thee.
verse.web: Now when they had departed, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream, saying, “Arise and take the young child and his mother, and flee into Egypt, and stay there until I tell you…
verse.es: Después que ellos partieron, un ángel del Señor apareció en sueños a Joseph diciéndole: Levántate, toma al niño y a su madre, y huye a Egypto, y estate allí hasta que yo te avise.

verse.en: And after the days of her purification, according to the law of Moses, were accomplished, they carried him to Jerusalem, to present him to the Lord: As it is written in the law of the Lord…
verse.web: When the days of their purification according to the law of Moses were fulfilled, they brought him up to Jerusalem to present him to the Lord (as it is written in the law of the Lord…
verse.es: Cumplido asimismo el tiempo de la purificación de la madre, según la ley de Moysés, llevaron al niño a Jerusalem, para presentarle al Señor, como está escrito en la Ley del Señor: Todo varón que nazca el primero…

verse.en: And there was one Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Aser. She was far advanced in years and had lived with her husband seven years from her virginity.
verse.web: There was one Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Asher (she was of a great age, having lived with a husband seven years from her virginity…
verse.es: Vivía entonces una profetisa llamada Anna, hija de Phanuel, de la tribu de Aser, que era ya de edad muy avanzada, y la cual, casada desde la flor de ella, vivió con su marido siete años.

verse.en: In the beginning was the Word: and the Word was with God: and the Word was God. The same was in the beginning with God. All things were made by him: and without him was made nothing that was made.
verse.web: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God. The same was in the beginning with God. All things were made through him. Without him, nothing was made that has been made.
verse.es: En el principio era ya el Verbo, y el Verbo estaba en Dios, y el Verbo era Dios. Él estaba en el principio en Dios.

celebration.en: Solemnity of Mary, the Holy Mother of God
celebration.es: Solemnidad de Santa María, Madre de Dios

verse.en: And they came with haste: and they found Mary and Joseph, and the infant lying in the manger. And seeing, they understood of the word that had been spoken to them concerning this child.
verse.web: They came with haste and found both Mary and Joseph, and the baby was lying in the feeding trough. When they saw it, they publicized widely the saying which was spoken to them about this child.
verse.es: Vinieron pues a toda priesa; y hallaron a María y a Joseph, y al niño reclinado en el pesebre. Y viéndole, se certificaron de cuanto se les había dicho de este niño.

celebration.en: Saints Basil the Great and Gregory Nazianzen, Bishops and Doctors of the Church
celebration.es: Santos Basilio Magno y Gregorio Nacianceno, obispos y doctores de la Iglesia

verse.en: And this is the testimony of John, when the Jews sent from Jerusalem priests and Levites to him, to ask him: Who art thou? And he confessed and did not deny: and he confessed: I am not the Christ.
verse.web: This is John’s testimony, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, “Who are you?” He declared, and didn’t deny, but he declared, “I am not the Christ.” They asked him, “What then?
verse.es: Y he aquí el testimonio que dio Juan a favor de Jesús, cuando los judíos le enviaron de Jerusalem sacerdotes y levitas, para preguntarle: ¿Tú quien eres?

verse.en: When Jesus therefore was born in Bethlehem of Juda, in the days of king Herod, behold, there came wise men from the East to Jerusalem, Saying: Where is he that is born king of the Jews?
verse.web: Now when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judea in the days of King Herod, behold, wise men from the east came to Jerusalem, saying, “Where is he who is born King of the Jews?
verse.es: Habiendo pues nacido Jesús en Bethlehem de Judá reinando Herodes, he aquí que unos magos vinieron del oriente a Jerusalem. preguntando: ¿Dónde está el nacido rey de los judíos?

verse.en: And when Jesus had heard that John was delivered up, he retired into Galilee: And leaving the city Nazareth, he came and dwelt in Capharnaum on the sea coast, in the borders of Zabulon and of Nephthalim…
verse.web: Now when Jesus heard that John was delivered up, he withdrew into Galilee.
verse.es: Oyendo después Jesús que Juan había sido encarcelado, retirose a Galilea; dejando la ciudad de Nazareth, fue a morar en Capharnaum, ciudad marítima, en los confines de Zabulón y Nephthalim…

verse.en: And Jesus going out saw a great multitude: and he had compassion on them, because they were as sheep not having a shepherd, and he began to teach them many things.
verse.web: Jesus came out, saw a great multitude, and he had compassion on them because they were like sheep without a shepherd; and he began to teach them many things.
verse.es: En desembarcando vio Jesús la mucha gente que le aguardaba; y enterneciéronsele con tal vista las entrañas, porque andaban como ovejas sin pastor, y así se puso a instruirlos en muchas cosas.

verse.en: And immediately he obliged his disciples to go up into the ship, that they might go before him over the water to Bethsaida, whilst he dismissed the people.
verse.web: Immediately he made his disciples get into the boat and go ahead to the other side, to Bethsaida, while he himself sent the multitude away. After he had taken leave of them, he went up the mountain to pray.
verse.es: Inmediatamente obligó a sus discípulos a subir en la barca, para que pasasen antes que él al otro lado del lago acia Bethsaida, mientras el despedía al pueblo. Así que le despidió, retiróse a orar en el monte.

verse.en: And Jesus returned in the power of the spirit, into Galilee: and the fame of him went out through the whole country. And he taught in their synagogues and was magnified by all.
verse.web: Jesus returned in the power of the Spirit into Galilee, and news about him spread through all the surrounding area. He taught in their synagogues, being glorified by all.
verse.es: Entonces Jesús por impulso del Espíritu santo retornó a Galilea, y corrió luego su fama por toda la comarca. Él enseñaba en sus synagogas, y era estimado y honrado de todos.

verse.en: And it came to pass, when he was in a certain city, behold a man full of leprosy who, seeing Jesus and falling on his face, besought him saying: Lord, if thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.
verse.web: While he was in one of the cities, behold, there was a man full of leprosy. When he saw Jesus, he fell on his face and begged him, saying, “Lord, if you want to, you can make me clean.”
verse.es: Estando en una de aquellas ciudades de Galilea, he aquí un hombre todo cubierto de lepra, el cual así que vio a Jesús, postrose rostro por tierra, y le rogaba diciendo: Señor, si tú quieres, puedes curarme.

verse.en: After these things, Jesus and his disciples came into the land of Judea: and there he abode with them and baptized. And John also was baptizing in Ennon near Salim: because there was much water there.
verse.web: After these things, Jesus came with his disciples into the land of Judea. He stayed there with them and baptized. John also was baptizing in Enon near Salim, because there was much water there.
verse.es: Después de esto se fue Jesús con sus discípulos a la Judea; y allí moraba con ellos, y bautizaba por medio de los mismos.

verse.en: And he preached, saying: There cometh after me one mightier than I, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to stoop down and loose. I have baptized you with water: but he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost.
verse.web: He preached, saying, “After me comes he who is mightier than I, the strap of whose sandals I am not worthy to stoop down and loosen. I baptized you in water, but he will baptize you in the Holy Spirit.”
verse.es: En pos de mí viene uno que es más poderoso que yo, ante el cual no soy digno ni de postrarme para desatar la correa de sus zapatos. Yo os he bautizado con agua, mas él os bautizará con el Espíritu santo.

verse.en: And after that John was delivered up, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the gospel of the kingdom of God, And saying: The time is accomplished and the kingdom of God is at hand.
verse.web: Now after John was taken into custody, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the Good News of God’s Kingdom, and saying, “The time is fulfilled, and God’s Kingdom is at hand! Repent, and believe in the Good News.”
verse.es: Pero después que Juan fue puesto en la cárcel, vino Jesús a la alta Galilea, predicando el Evangelio del reino de Dios, y diciendo: Se ha cumplido ya el tiempo, y el reino de Dios está cerca: haced penitencia…

verse.en: And they entered into Capharnaum: and forthwith upon the sabbath days going into the synagogue, he taught them. And they were astonished at his doctrine.
verse.web: They went into Capernaum, and immediately on the Sabbath day he entered into the synagogue and taught. They were astonished at his teaching, for he taught them as having authority, and not as the scribes.
verse.es: Entraron después en Capharnaum; y Jesús comenzó luego en los sábados a enseñar al pueblo en la synagoga.

verse.en: And immediately going out of the synagogue they came into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John. And Simon’s wife’s mother lay in a fit of a fever: and forthwith they tell him of her.
verse.web: Immediately, when they had come out of the synagogue, they came into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John. Now Simon’s wife’s mother lay sick with a fever, and immediately they told him about her.
verse.es: Así que salieron de la synagoga, fueron con Santiago y Juan a casa de Simón y de Andrés. Hallábase la suegra de Simón en cama con calentura, y habláronle luego de ella.

verse.en: And there came a leper to him, beseeching him and kneeling down, said to him: If thou wilt thou canst make me clean. And Jesus, having compassion on him, stretched forth his hand and touching him saith to him: I will.
verse.web: A leper came to him, begging him, kneeling down to him, and saying to him, “If you want to, you can make me clean.” Being moved with compassion, he stretched out his hand, and touched him, and said to him, “I want to.
verse.es: Vino también a él un leproso a pedirle favor; e hincándose de rodillas, le dijo: Si tu quieres, puedes curarme. Jesús compadeciéndose de el, extendió la mano, y tocándole, le dice: Quiero; sé curado.

verse.en: And again he entered into Capharnaum after some days. And it was heard that he was in the house. And many came together, so that there was no room: no, not even at the door. And he spoke to them the word.
verse.web: When he entered again into Capernaum after some days, it was heard that he was at home. Immediately many were gathered together, so that there was no more room, not even around the door; and he spoke the word to them.
verse.es: Al cabo de algunos días volvió a entrar en Capharnaum; y corriendo la voz de que estaba en la casa, acudieron muchos en tanto número, que no cabían ni dentro ni aun fuera delante de la puerta…

verse.en: And he went forth again to the sea side: and all the multitude came to him. And he taught them.
verse.web: He went out again by the seaside. All the multitude came to him, and he taught them. As he passed by, he saw Levi the son of Alphaeus sitting at the tax office. He said to him, “Follow me.” And he arose and followed him.
verse.es: Otra vez salió acia el mar; y todas las gentes se iban en pos de él, y las adoctrinaba. Al paso vio a Levi, hijo de Alpheo, sentado al banco o mesa de los tributos, y díjole: Sígueme.

verse.en: The next day again John stood and two of his disciples. And beholding Jesus walking, he saith: Behold the Lamb of God. And the two disciples heard him speak: and they followed Jesus.
verse.web: Again, the next day, John was standing with two of his disciples, and he looked at Jesus as he walked, and said, “Behold, the Lamb of God!” The two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Jesus.
verse.es: Al día siguiente otra vez estaba Juan allí con dos de sus discípulos. Y viendo a Jesús que pasaba, dijo: He aquí el cordero de Dios. Los dos discípulos al oírle hablar así, se fueron en pos de Jesús.

verse.en: And the disciples of John and the Pharisees used to fast. And they come and say to him: Why do the disciples of John and of the Pharisees fast; but thy disciples do not fast?
verse.web: John’s disciples and the Pharisees were fasting, and they came and asked him, “Why do John’s disciples and the disciples of the Pharisees fast, but your disciples don’t fast?”
verse.es: Siendo también los discípulos de Juan y los Fariseos muy dados al ayuno, vinieron a preguntarle: ¿No nos dirás por qué razón, ayunando los discípulos de Juan y los de los Fariseos, no ayunan tus discípulos?

verse.en: And it came to pass again, as the Lord walked through the corn fields on the sabbath, that his disciples began to go forward and to pluck the ears of corn.
verse.web: He was going on the Sabbath day through the grain fields; and his disciples began, as they went, to pluck the ears of grain.
verse.es: En otra ocasión, caminando el Señor por junto a unos sembrados un día de sábado, sus discípulos se adelantaron, y empezaron a coger espigas y a comer el grano.

verse.en: And he entered again into the synagogue: and there was a man there who had a withered hand. And they watched him whether he would heal on the sabbath days, that they might accuse him.
verse.web: He entered again into the synagogue, and there was a man there whose hand was withered. They watched him, whether he would heal him on the Sabbath day, that they might accuse him.
verse.es: Otra vez en sábado entró Jesús en la synagoga, y hallábase en ella un hombre que tenía seca una mano. Y le estaban acechando si curaría en día de sábado, para acusarle.

verse.en: But Jesus retired with his disciples to the sea; and a great multitude followed him from Galilee and Judea, And from Jerusalem, and from Idumea and from beyond the Jordan.
verse.web: Jesus withdrew to the sea with his disciples; and a great multitude followed him from Galilee, from Judea, from Jerusalem, from Idumaea, beyond the Jordan, and those from around Tyre and Sidon.
verse.es: Y Jesús con sus discípulos se retiró a la ribera del mar de Tiberiades; y le fue siguiendo mucha gente de Galilea y de Judea, y de Jerusalem, y de la Idumea, y del otro lado del Jordán…

celebration.en: Day of Prayer for the Legal Protection of Unborn Children
celebration.es: Día de oración por la protección legal de la criatura en el vientre materno

verse.en: And going up into a mountain, he called unto him whom he would himself: and they came to him. And he made that twelve should be with him, and that he might send them to preach.
verse.web: He went up into the mountain and called to himself those whom he wanted, and they went to him.
verse.es: Subiendo después Jesús a un monte, llamó a sí a aquellos de sus discípulos que le plugo; y llegados que fueron, escogió doce para tenerlos consigo, y enviarlos a predicar; dándoles potestad de curar enfermedades…

verse.en: And they come to a house, and the multitude cometh together again, so that they could not so much as eat bread. And when his friends had heard of it, they went out to lay hold on him. For they said: He is become mad.
verse.web: The multitude came together again, so that they could not so much as eat bread. When his friends heard it, they went out to seize him; for they said, “He is insane.”
verse.es: De aquí vinieron a la casa, y concurrió de nuevo tal tropel de gente, que ni siquiera podían tomar alimento.

verse.en: And after that John was delivered up, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the gospel of the kingdom of God, And saying: The time is accomplished and the kingdom of God is at hand.
verse.web: Now after John was taken into custody, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the Good News of God’s Kingdom, and saying, “The time is fulfilled, and God’s Kingdom is at hand! Repent, and believe in the Good News.”
verse.es: Pero después que Juan fue puesto en la cárcel, vino Jesús a la alta Galilea, predicando el Evangelio del reino de Dios, y diciendo: Se ha cumplido ya el tiempo, y el reino de Dios está cerca: haced penitencia…

celebration.en: The Conversion of Saint Paul the Apostle

verse.en: And he said to them: Go ye into the whole world and preach the gospel to every creature. He that believeth and is baptized shall be saved: but he that believeth not shall be condemned.
verse.web: He said to them, “Go into all the world and preach the Good News to the whole creation. He who believes and is baptized will be saved; but he who disbelieves will be condemned.
verse.es: Por último les dijo: Id por todo el mundo: predicad el Evangelio a todas las criaturas. El que creyere, y se bautizare, se salvará; pero el que no creyere, será condenado.

verse.en: And his mother and his brethren came; and standing without, sent unto him, calling him. And the multitude sat about him; and they say to him: Behold thy mother and thy brethren without seek for thee.
verse.web: His mother and his brothers came, and standing outside, they sent to him, calling him.
verse.es: Entre tanto llegan su madre y hermanos o parientes; y quedándose fuera a la puerta, enviaron a llamarle. Estaba mucha gente sentada al rededor de él, cuando le dicen: Mira que tu madre y tus hermanos ahí fuera te buscan.

verse.en: And again he began to teach by the sea side; and a great multitude was gathered together unto him, so that he went up into a ship and sat in the sea: and all the multitude was upon the land by the sea side.
verse.web: Again he began to teach by the seaside. A great multitude was gathered to him, so that he entered into a boat in the sea and sat down. All the multitude were on the land by the sea.
verse.es: Otra vez se puso a enseñar cerca del mar; y acudió tanta gente, que le fue preciso subir en una barca y sentarse en ella dentro del mar, estando todo el auditorio en tierra a la orilla.

celebration.en: Saint Thomas Aquinas, Priest and Doctor of the Church
celebration.es: Santo Tomás de Aquino, presbítero y doctor de la Iglesia

verse.en: And he said to them: Doth a candle come in to be put under a bushel, or under a bed? and not to be set on a candlestick?
verse.web: He said to them, “Is a lamp brought to be put under a basket or under a bed? Isn’t it put on a stand?
verse.es: Decíales también: ¿Por ventura se trae o enciende una luz para ponerla debajo de algún celemín, o debajo de la cama? ¿no es para ponerla sobre un candelero?

verse.en: And he said: So is the kingdom of God, as if a man should cast seed into the earth, And should sleep, and rise, night and day, and the seed should spring, and grow up whilst he knoweth not.
verse.web: He said, “God’s Kingdom is as if a man should cast seed on the earth, and should sleep and rise night and day, and the seed should spring up and grow, though he doesn’t know how.
verse.es: Decía asimismo: El reino de Dios viene a ser a manera de un hombre que siembra su heredad, y ya duerma, o vele noche y día, el grano va brotando, y creciendo sin que el hombre lo advierta.

verse.en: And he saith to them that day, when evening was come: Let us pass over to the other side. And sending away the multitude, they take him even as he was in the ship: and there were other ships with him.
verse.web: On that day, when evening had come, he said to them, “Let’s go over to the other side.” Leaving the multitude, they took him with them, even as he was, in the boat. Other small boats were also with him.
verse.es: En aquel mismo día, siendo ya tarde, les dijo: Pasemos a la ribera de en frente. Y despidiendo al pueblo, estando Jesús como estaba en la barca, se hicieron con él a la vela, y le iban acompañando otros varios barcos.

verse.en: And they entered into Capharnaum: and forthwith upon the sabbath days going into the synagogue, he taught them. And they were astonished at his doctrine.
verse.web: They went into Capernaum, and immediately on the Sabbath day he entered into the synagogue and taught. They were astonished at his teaching, for he taught them as having authority, and not as the scribes.
verse.es: Entraron después en Capharnaum; y Jesús comenzó luego en los sábados a enseñar al pueblo en la synagoga.

verse.en: And they came over the strait of the sea, into the country of the Gerasens.
verse.web: They came to the other side of the sea, into the country of the Gadarenes. When he had come out of the boat, immediately a man with an unclean spirit met him out of the tombs. He lived in the tombs.
verse.es: Pasaron después al otro lado del lago al territorio de los gerasenos.

verse.en: And after the days of her purification, according to the law of Moses, were accomplished, they carried him to Jerusalem, to present him to the Lord: As it is written in the law of the Lord…
verse.web: When the days of their purification according to the law of Moses were fulfilled, they brought him up to Jerusalem to present him to the Lord (as it is written in the law of the Lord…
verse.es: Cumplido asimismo el tiempo de la purificación de la madre, según la ley de Moysés, llevaron al niño a Jerusalem, para presentarle al Señor, como está escrito en la Ley del Señor: Todo varón que nazca el primero…

verse.en: And going out from thence, he went into his own country; and his disciples followed him.
verse.web: He went out from there. He came into his own country, and his disciples followed him.
verse.es: Partido de aquí, se fue a su patria; y le seguían sus discípulos: llegado el sábado, comenzó a enseñar en la synagoga; y muchos de los oyentes admirados de su sabiduría, decían…

verse.en: And he called the twelve; and began to send them two and two, and gave them power over unclean spirits.
verse.web: He called to himself the twelve, and began to send them out two by two; and he gave them authority over the unclean spirits.
verse.es: Y habiendo convocado a los doce, comenzó a enviarlos de dos en dos a predicar, dándoles potestad sobre los espíritus inmundos.

verse.en: And king Herod heard, (for his name was made manifest,) and he said: John the Baptist is risen again from the dead, and therefore mighty works shew forth themselves in him. And others said: It is Elias.
verse.web: King Herod heard this, for his name had become known, and he said, “John the Baptizer has risen from the dead, and therefore these powers are at work in him.” But others said, “He is Elijah.”
verse.es: Oyendo estas cosas el rey Herodes (pues se había hecho ya célebre el nombre de Jesús) decía: Sin duda que Juan Bautista ha resucitado de entre los muertos; y por eso tiene la virtud de hacer milagros.

celebration.en: Saint Paul Miki and Companions, Martyrs
celebration.es: Santos Pablo Miki y compañeros, mártires

verse.en: And the apostles coming together unto Jesus, related to him all things that they had done and taught. And he said to them: Come apart into a desert place, and rest a little.
verse.web: The apostles gathered themselves together to Jesus, and they told him all things, whatever they had done, and whatever they had taught. He said to them, “Come away into a deserted place, and rest awhile.”
verse.es: Los apóstoles pues, de vuelta de su misión, reuniéndose con Jesús, le dieron cuenta de todo lo que habían hecho, y enseñado. Y él les dijo: Venid a retiraros conmigo en un lugar solitario, y reposaréis un poquito.

verse.en: And immediately going out of the synagogue they came into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John. And Simon’s wife’s mother lay in a fit of a fever: and forthwith they tell him of her.
verse.web: Immediately, when they had come out of the synagogue, they came into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John. Now Simon’s wife’s mother lay sick with a fever, and immediately they told him about her.
verse.es: Así que salieron de la synagoga, fueron con Santiago y Juan a casa de Simón y de Andrés. Hallábase la suegra de Simón en cama con calentura, y habláronle luego de ella.

verse.en: And when they had passed over, they came into the land of Genezareth, and set to the shore.
verse.web: When they had crossed over, they came to land at Gennesaret and moored to the shore.
verse.es: Atravesado pues el lago, arribaron a tierra de Genesareth, y abordaron allí. Apenas desembarcaron, cuando luego fue conocido.

verse.en: And there assembled together unto him the Pharisees and some of the scribes, coming from Jerusalem. And when they had seen some of his disciples eat bread with common, that is, with unwashed hands, they found fault.
verse.web: Then the Pharisees and some of the scribes gathered together to him, having come from Jerusalem. Now when they saw some of his disciples eating bread with defiled, that is unwashed, hands, they found fault.
verse.es: Acercáronse a Jesús los Fariseos, y algunos de los Escribas venidos de Jerusalem. Y habiendo observado que algunos de sus discípulos comían con manos inmundas, esto es, sin habérselas lavado, se lo vituperaron.

verse.en: Take heed that you do not your justice before men, to be seen by them: otherwise you shall not have a reward of your Father who is in heaven.
verse.web: “Be careful that you don’t do your charitable giving before men, to be seen by them, or else you have no reward from your Father who is in heaven.
verse.es: Guardaos bien de hacer vuestras obras buenas en presencia de los hombres, con el fin de que os vean: de otra manera no recibiréis su galardón de vuestro Padre, que está en los cielos.

verse.en: Saying: The Son of man must suffer many things and be rejected by the ancients and chief priests and scribes and be killed and the third day rise again.
verse.web: saying, “The Son of Man must suffer many things, and be rejected by the elders, chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and the third day be raised up.”
verse.es: y añadió: Porque conviene que el Hijo del hombre padezca muchos tormentos, y sea condenado por los Ancianos, y los príncipes de los sacerdotes, y los Escribas, y sea muerto, y resucite después al tercer día.

verse.en: Then came to him the disciples of John, saying: Why do we and the Pharisees, fast often, but thy disciples do not fast?
verse.web: Then John’s disciples came to him, saying, “Why do we and the Pharisees fast often, but your disciples don’t fast?” Jesus said to them, “Can the friends of the bridegroom mourn as long as the bridegroom is with them?
verse.es: Entonces se presentaron a Jesús los discípulos de Juan, y le dijeron: ¿Cuál es el motivo por que, ayunando frecuentemente nosotros y los Fariseos, tus discípulos no ayunan?

verse.en: And after these things, he went forth and saw a publican named Levi, sitting at the receipt of custom: and he said to him: Follow me. And leaving all things, he rose up and followed him.
verse.web: After these things he went out and saw a tax collector named Levi sitting at the tax office, and said to him, “Follow me!” He left everything, and rose up and followed him. Levi made a great feast for him in his house.
verse.es: Después de esto, saliendo a fuera, acia el lago de Genesareth, vio a un publicano llamado Leví, sentado al banco o mesa de los tributos, y díjole: Sígueme. Y Leví abandonándolo todo, se levantó y le siguió.

verse.en: And immediately the Spirit drove him out into the desert. And he was in the desert forty days and forty nights, and was tempted by Satan. And he was with beasts: and the angels ministered to him.
verse.web: Immediately the Spirit drove him out into the wilderness. He was there in the wilderness forty days, tempted by Satan. He was with the wild animals; and the angels were serving him.
verse.es: Luego después el mismo Espíritu le arrebató al desierto, donde se mantuvo cuarenta días y cuarenta noches. Allí fue tentado de Satanás: y moraba entre las fieras, y los ángeles le servían.

verse.en: And when the Son of man shall come in his majesty, and all the angels with him, then shall he sit upon the seat of his majesty.
verse.web: “But when the Son of Man comes in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then he will sit on the throne of his glory.
verse.es: Cuando venga pues el Hijo del hombre con toda su magestad, y acompañado de todos sus ángeles, sentarse ha entonces en el trono de su gloria; y hará comparecer delante de el a todas las naciones…

verse.en: And when you are praying, speak not much, as the heathens. For they think that in their much speaking they may be heard.
verse.web: In praying, don’t use vain repetitions as the Gentiles do; for they think that they will be heard for their much speaking. Therefore don’t be like them, for your Father knows what things you need before you ask him.
verse.es: En la oración no afectéis hablar mucho, como hacen los gentiles, que se imaginan haber de ser oídos a fuerza de palabras. No queráis pues imitarlos; que bien sabe vuestro Padre lo que habéis menester, antes de pedírselo.

verse.en: And the multitudes running together, he began to say: This generation is a wicked generation. It asketh a sign: and a sign shall not be given it, but the sign of Jonas the prophet.
verse.web: When the multitudes were gathering together to him, he began to say, “This is an evil generation. It seeks after a sign. No sign will be given to it but the sign of Jonah the prophet.
verse.es: Como concurriesen las turbas a oírle, comenzó a decir: Esta raza de hombres es una raza perversa: ellos piden un prodigio, y no se les dará otro prodigio que el del Profeta Jonás.

verse.en: Ask, and it shall be given you: seek, and you shall find: knock, and it shall be opened to you. For every one that asketh, receiveth: and he that seeketh, findeth: and to him that knocketh, it shall be opened.
verse.web: “Ask, and it will be given you. Seek, and you will find. Knock, and it will be opened for you. For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.
verse.es: Pedid, y se os dará; buscad, y hallaréis; llamad, y os abrirán. Porque todo aquel que pide, recibe; y el que busca, halla; y al que llama, se le abrirá.

verse.en: For I tell you, that unless your justice abound more than that of the scribes and Pharisees, you shall not enter into the kingdom of heaven. You have heard that it was said to them of old: Thou shalt not kill.
verse.web: For I tell you that unless your righteousness exceeds that of the scribes and Pharisees, there is no way you will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven.
verse.es: Porque yo os digo, que si vuestra justicia no es más llena y mayor que la de los Escribas y Fariseos, no entraréis en el reino de los cielos.

verse.en: You have heard that it hath been said, Thou shalt love thy neighbour, and hate thy enemy.
verse.web: “You have heard that it was said, ‘You shall love your neighbor and hate your enemy.’
verse.es: Habéis oído que fue dicho: Amarás a tu prójimo, y (han añadido malamente) tendrás odio a tu enemigo.

verse.en: And after six days, Jesus taketh with him Peter and James and John, and leadeth them up into an high mountain apart by themselves, and was transfigured before them.
verse.web: After six days Jesus took with him Peter, James, and John, and brought them up onto a high mountain privately by themselves, and he was changed into another form in front of them.
verse.es: Seis días después tomó Jesús consigo a Pedro, y a Santiago, y a Juan; y condújolos solos a un elevado monte, en lugar apartado, y se trasfiguró en presencia de ellos.

celebration.en: The Chair of Saint Peter the Apostle

verse.en: And Jesus came into the quarters of Cesarea Philippi: and he asked his disciples, saying: Whom do men say that the Son of man is?
verse.web: Now when Jesus came into the parts of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, saying, “Who do men say that I, the Son of Man, am?”
verse.es: Viniendo después Jesús al territorio de Cesarea de Philippo, preguntó a sus discípulos: ¿Quién dicen los hombres que es el Hijo del hombre?

verse.en: Then Jesus spoke to the multitudes and to his disciples, Saying: The scribes and the Pharisees have sitten on the chair of Moses.
verse.web: Then Jesus spoke to the multitudes and to his disciples, saying, “The scribes and the Pharisees sit on Moses’ seat.
verse.es: Entonces dirigiendo Jesús su palabra al pueblo, y a sus discípulos, les dijo: Los Escribas, o doctores de la Ley, y los Fariseos están sentados en la cátedra de Moysés.

verse.en: And Jesus going up to Jerusalem, took the twelve disciples apart and said to them: Behold we go up to Jerusalem, and the Son of man shall be betrayed to the chief priests and the scribes…
verse.web: As Jesus was going up to Jerusalem, he took the twelve disciples aside, and on the way he said to them, “Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem, and the Son of Man will be delivered to the chief priests and scribes…
verse.es: Poniéndose Jesús en camino para Jerusalem, tomó a parte a sus doce discípulos, y les dijo: Mirad que vamos a Jerusalem, donde el Hijo del hombre ha de ser entregado a los príncipes de los sacerdotes y a los Escribas…

verse.en: There was a certain rich man who was clothed in purple and fine linen and feasted sumptuously every day.
verse.web: “Now there was a certain rich man, and he was clothed in purple and fine linen, living in luxury every day.
verse.es: Hubo cierto hombre muy rico, que se vestía de púrpura y de lino finísimo, y tenía cada día espléndidos banquetes.

verse.en: Hear ye another parable. There was a man, an householder, who planted a vineyard and made a hedge round about it and dug in it a press and built a tower and let it out to husbandmen and went into a strange country.
verse.web: “Hear another parable. There was a man who was a master of a household who planted a vineyard, set a hedge about it, dug a wine press in it, built a tower, leased it out to farmers, and went into another country.
verse.es: Escuchad otra parábola: Érase un padre de familias, que plantó una viña, y la cercó de vallado, y cavando hizo en ella un lagar, edificó una torre, arrendola después a ciertos labradores, y se ausentó a un país lejano.

verse.en: Now the publicans and sinners drew near unto him to hear him. And the Pharisees and the scribes murmured, saying: This man receiveth sinners and eateth with them.
verse.web: Now all the tax collectors and sinners were coming close to him to hear him. The Pharisees and the scribes murmured, saying, “This man welcomes sinners, and eats with them.”
verse.es: Solían los publicanos, y pecadores acercarse a Jesús para oírle. Y los Fariseos y Escribas murmuraban de eso diciendo: Mirad cómo se familiariza con los pecadores, y come con ellos.

verse.en: And the pasch of the Jews was at hand: and Jesus went up to Jerusalem. And he found in the temple them that sold oxen and sheep and doves, and the changers of money sitting.
verse.web: The Passover of the Jews was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem. He found in the temple those who sold oxen, sheep, and doves, and the changers of money sitting.
verse.es: Estaba ya cerca la Pascua de los judíos, y Jesús subió a Jerusalem; y encontrando en el Templo gentes que vendían bueyes, y ovejas, y palomas, y cambistas sentados en sus mesas…

verse.en: And he said: Amen I say to you that no prophet is accepted in his own country.
verse.web: He said, “Most certainly I tell you, no prophet is acceptable in his hometown.
verse.es: Mas añadió luego: En verdad os digo, que ningún Profeta es bien recibido en su patria.

verse.en: Then came Peter unto him and said: Lord, how often shall my brother offend against me, and I forgive him? till seven times? Jesus saith to him: I say not to thee, till seven times; but till seventy times seven times.
verse.web: Then Peter came and said to him, “Lord, how often shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? Until seven times?” Jesus said to him, “I don’t tell you until seven times, but, until seventy times seven.
verse.es: En esta sazón, arrimándosele Pedro, le dijo: Señor, ¿cuántas veces deberé perdonar a mi hermano, cuando pecare contra mi? ¿hasta siete veces?

verse.en: Do not think that I am come to destroy the law, or the prophets. I am not come to destroy, but to fulfil.
verse.web: “Don’t think that I came to destroy the law or the prophets. I didn’t come to destroy, but to fulfill.
verse.es: No penséis que yo he venido a destruir la doctrina de la Ley, ni de los Profetas: no he venido a destruirla, sino a darle su cumplimiento.

verse.en: And he was casting out a devil: and the same was dumb. And when he had cast out the devil, the dumb spoke: and the multitudes, were in admiration at it.
verse.web: He was casting out a demon, and it was mute. When the demon had gone out, the mute man spoke; and the multitudes marveled. But some of them said, “He casts out demons by Beelzebul, the prince of the demons.”
verse.es: Otro día estaba Jesús lanzando un demonio, el cual era mudo. Y así que hubo echado al demonio, habló el mudo, y todas las gentes quedaron muy admiradas.

verse.en: And there came one of the scribes that had heard them reasoning together, and seeing that he had answered them well, asked him which was the first commandment of all.
verse.web: One of the scribes came and heard them questioning together, and knowing that he had answered them well, asked him, “Which commandment is the greatest of all?”
verse.es: Uno de los Escribas, que había oído esta disputa, viendo lo bien que les había respondido, se arrimó, y le preguntó, cuál era el primero de todos los mandamientos.

verse.en: And to some who trusted in themselves as just and despised others, he spoke also this parable: Two men went up into the temple to pray: the one a Pharisee and the other a publican.
verse.web: He also spoke this parable to certain people who were convinced of their own righteousness, and who despised all others: “Two men went up into the temple to pray; one was a Pharisee, and the other was a tax collector.
verse.es: Dijo asimismo a ciertos hombres, que presumían de justos, y despreciaban a los demás, esta parábola: Dos hombres subieron al Templo a orar: el uno era Fariseo, y el otro publicano o alcabalero.

verse.en: And as Moses lifted up the serpent in the desert, so must the Son of man be lifted up: That whosoever believeth in him may not perish, but may have life everlasting.
verse.web: As Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of Man be lifted up, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
verse.es: Al modo que Moysés en el Desierto levantó en alto la serpiente de bronce, así también es menester que el Hijo del hombre sea levantado en alto; para que todo aquel que crea en él, no perezca…

verse.en: Now after two days, he departed thence and went into Galilee. For Jesus himself gave testimony that a prophet hath no honour in his own country.
verse.web: After the two days he went out from there and went into Galilee. For Jesus himself testified that a prophet has no honor in his own country.
verse.es: Pasados pues dos días salió de allí; y prosiguió su viage a Galilea. Porque el mismo Jesús había atestiguado que un Profeta por lo regular no es mirado con veneración en su patria.

verse.en: After these things was a festival day of the Jews: and Jesus went up to Jerusalem. Now there is at Jerusalem a pond, called Probatica, which in Hebrew is named Bethsaida, having five porches.
verse.web: After these things, there was a feast of the Jews, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem. Now in Jerusalem by the sheep gate, there is a pool, which is called in Hebrew, “Bethesda”, having five porches.
verse.es: Después de esto, siendo la fiesta de los judíos, partió Jesús a Jerusalem. Hay en Jerusalem una piscina, o estanque, dicha de las ovejas, llamada en hebreo Bethsaida, la cual tiene cinco pórticos.

verse.en: But Jesus answered them: My Father worketh until now; and I work.
verse.web: But Jesus answered them, “My Father is still working, so I am working, too.”
verse.es: Entonces Jesús les dijo: Mi Padre hoy como siempre está obrando incesantemente, y yo ni más ni menos.

verse.en: If I bear witness of myself, my witness is not true. There is another that beareth witness of me: and I know that the witness which he witnesseth of me is true. You sent to John: and he gave testimony to the truth.
verse.web: “If I testify about myself, my witness is not valid. It is another who testifies about me. I know that the testimony which he testifies about me is true. You have sent to John, and he has testified to the truth.
verse.es: Vosotros estáis pensando que si yo doy testimonio de mí mismo, mi testimonio no es idóneo. Mas otro hay que da testimonio de mí; y sé que es testimonio idóneo el que da de mí, y que vosotros no podéis desecharle.

verse.en: After these things, Jesus walked in Galilee: for he would not walk in Judea, because the Jews sought to kill him. Now the Jews feast of tabernacles was at hand.
