verse.en: As the Father hath loved me, I also have loved you. Abide in my love. If you keep my commandments, you shall abide in my love: as I also have kept my Father’s commandments and do abide in his love.
verse.web: Even as the Father has loved me, I also have loved you. Remain in my love. If you keep my commandments, you will remain in my love, even as I have kept my Father’s commandments and remain in his love.
verse.es: Al modo que mi Padre me amó, así os he amado yo. Perseverad en mi amor. Si observareis mis preceptos, perseveraréis en mi amor, así como yo también he guardado los preceptos de mi Padre, y persevero en su amor.

verse.en: This is my commandment, that you love one another, as I have loved you. Greater love than this no man hath, that a man lay down his life for his friends. You are my friends, if you do the things that I command you.
verse.web: “This is my commandment, that you love one another, even as I have loved you. Greater love has no one than this, that someone lay down his life for his friends. You are my friends if you do whatever I command you.
verse.es: El precepto mío es, que os améis unos a otros, como yo os he amado a vosotros. Que nadie tiene amor más grande, que el que da su vida por sus amigos. Vosotros sois mis amigos, si hacéis lo que yo os mando.

verse.en: If the world hate you, know ye that it hath hated me before you.
verse.web: If the world hates you, you know that it has hated me before it hated you. If you were of the world, the world would love its own.
verse.es: Si el mundo os aborrece, sabed que primero que a vosotros me aborreció a mí.

verse.en: Jesus answered and said to him: If any one love me, he will keep my word. And my Father will love him and we will come to him and will make our abode with him. He that loveth me not keepeth not my words.
verse.web: Jesus answered him, “If a man loves me, he will keep my word. My Father will love him, and we will come to him and make our home with him. He who doesn’t love me doesn’t keep my words.
verse.es: Jesús le respondió así: Cualquiera que me ama, observará mi doctrina, y mi Padre le amará, y vendremos a él, y haremos mansión dentro de él. Pero el que no me ama, no practica mi doctrina.

verse.en: But when the Paraclete cometh, whom I will send you from the Father, the Spirit of truth, who proceedeth from the Father, he shall give testimony of me.
verse.web: “When the Counselor has come, whom I will send to you from the Father, the Spirit of truth, who proceeds from the Father, he will testify about me. You will also testify, because you have been with me from the beginning.
verse.es: Mas cuando viniere el Consolador, el Espíritu de verdad que procede del Padre, y que yo os enviaré de parte de mi Padre, él dará testimonio de mí; y también vosotros daréis testimonio…

verse.en: And now I go to him that sent me, and none of you asketh me: Whither goest thou? But because I have spoken these things to you, sorrow hath filled your heart. But I tell you the truth: it is expedient to you that I go.
verse.web: But now I am going to him who sent me, and none of you asks me, ‘Where are you going?’ But because I have told you these things, sorrow has filled your heart.
verse.es: mas ahora me voy a aquel que me envió, y ninguno de vosotros me pregunta: ¿A dónde vas? Porque os he dicho estas cosas, vuestro corazón se ha llenado de tristeza.

verse.en: I have yet many things to say to you: but you cannot bear them now. But when he, the Spirit of truth, is come, he will teach you all truth.
verse.web: “I still have many things to tell you, but you can’t bear them now.
verse.es: Aún tengo otras muchas cosas que deciros; mas por ahora no podéis comprenderlas.

verse.en: A little while, and now you shall not see me: and again a little while, and you shall see me: because I go to the Father.
verse.web: “A little while, and you will not see me. Again a little while, and you will see me.”
verse.es: Dentro de poco ya no me veréis; mas poco después en resucitando, me volveréis a ver, porque me voy al Padre.

verse.en: Amen, amen, I say to you, that you shall lament and weep, but the world shall rejoice: and you shall be made sorrowful, but your sorrow shall be turned into joy.
verse.web: Most certainly I tell you that you will weep and lament, but the world will rejoice. You will be sorrowful, but your sorrow will be turned into joy. A woman, when she gives birth, has sorrow because her time has come.
verse.es: En verdad, en verdad os digo, que vosotros lloraréis y plañiréis, mientras el mundo se regocijará: os contristaréis; pero vuestra tristeza se convertirá en gozo.

verse.en: And in that day you shall not ask me any thing. Amen, amen, I say to you: if you ask the Father any thing in my name, he will give it you. Hitherto, you have not asked any thing in my name.
verse.web: “In that day you will ask me no questions. Most certainly I tell you, whatever you may ask of the Father in my name, he will give it to you. Until now, you have asked nothing in my name.
verse.es: Entonces no habréis de preguntarme cosa alguna. En verdad, en verdad os digo, que cuanto pidiereis al Padre en mi nombre, os lo concederá.

verse.en: And he said to them: Thus it is written, and thus it behoved Christ to suffer and to rise again from the dead, the third day: And that penance and remission of sins should be preached in his name, unto all nations…
verse.web: He said to them, “Thus it is written, and thus it was necessary for the Christ to suffer and to rise from the dead the third day…
verse.es: y les dijo: Así estaba ya escrito, y así era necesario que el Christo padeciese, y que resucitase de entre los muertos al tercero día…

verse.en: His disciples say to him: Behold, now thou speakest plainly and speakest no proverb. Now we know that thou knowest all things and thou needest not that any man should ask thee.
verse.web: His disciples said to him, “Behold, now you are speaking plainly, and using no figures of speech. Now we know that you know all things, and don’t need for anyone to question you.
verse.es: Dícenle sus discípulos: Ahora sí que hablas claro, y no en proverbios: ahora conocemos que tú lo sabes todo, y no has menester que nadie te haga preguntas: por donde creemos que has salido de Dios.

verse.en: These things Jesus spoke: and lifting up his eyes to heaven, he said: Father, the hour is come. Glorify thy Son, that thy Son may glorify thee.
verse.web: Jesus said these things, then lifting up his eyes to heaven, he said, “Father, the time has come.
verse.es: Estas cosas habló Jesús; y levantando los ojos al cielo, dijo: Padre mío, la hora es llegada, glorifica a tu Hijo, para que tu Hijo te glorifique a ti: pues que le has dado poder sobre todo el linage humano…

celebration.en: The Visitation of the Blessed Virgin Mary
celebration.es: Visitación de la Bienaventurada Virgen María

verse.en: And Mary rising up in those days, went into the hill country with haste into a city of Juda. And she entered into the house of Zachary and saluted Elizabeth.
verse.web: Mary arose in those days and went into the hill country with haste, into a city of Judah, and entered into the house of Zacharias and greeted Elizabeth.
verse.es: Por aquellos días partió María, y se fue apresuradamente a las montañas de Judea a una ciudad de la tribu de Judá; y habiendo entrado en la casa de Zachârías, saludó a Elisabeth.

verse.en: And not for them only do I pray, but for them also who through their word shall believe in me.
verse.web: “Not for these only do I pray, but for those also who will believe in me through their word, that they may all be one; even as you, Father, are in me, and I in you, that they also may be one in us…
verse.es: Pero no ruego solamente por estos, sino también por aquellos que han de creer en mí por medio de su predicación: ruego que todos sean una misma cosa, y que como tú ¡oh Padre!

verse.en: When therefore they had dined, Jesus saith to Simon Peter: Simon, son of John, lovest thou me more than these? He saith to him: Yea, Lord, thou knowest that I love thee. He saith to him: Feed my lambs.
verse.web: So when they had eaten their breakfast, Jesus said to Simon Peter, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me more than these?” He said to him, “Yes, Lord; you know that I have affection for you.”
verse.es: Acabada la comida, dice Jesús a Simón Pedro: Simón, hijo de Juan, ¿me amas tú más que estos? Dícele: Si, Señor, tú sabes que te amo. Dícele: Apacienta mis corderos. Segunda vez le dice: Simón, hijo de Juan, ¿me amas?

celebration.en: Saint Charles Lwanga and Companions, Martyrs
celebration.es: Santos Carlos Lwanga y compañeros, mártires

verse.en: Peter turning about, saw that disciple whom Jesus loved following, who also leaned on his breast at supper and said: Lord, who is he that shall betray thee?
verse.web: Then Peter, turning around, saw a disciple following. This was the disciple whom Jesus loved, the one who had also leaned on Jesus’ chest at the supper and asked, “Lord, who is going to betray you?”
verse.es: Volviéndose Pedro a mirar, vio venir detrás al discípulo amado de Jesús, aquel que en la cena se reclinara sobre su pecho, y había preguntado: Señor, ¿quién es el que te hará traición?

verse.en: Now when it was late the same day, the first of the week, and the doors were shut, where the disciples were gathered together, for fear of the Jews, Jesus came and stood in the midst and said to them: Peace be to you.
verse.web: When therefore it was evening on that day, the first day of the week, and when the doors were locked where the disciples were assembled, for fear of the Jews, Jesus came and stood in the middle and said to them…
verse.es: Aquel mismo día, primero de la semana, siendo ya muy tarde, y estando cerradas las puertas de la casa, donde se hallaban reunidos los discípulos por miedo de los judíos, vino Jesús, y apareciéndose en medio de ellos…

celebration.en: The Blessed Virgin Mary, Mother of the Church
celebration.es: Bienaventurada Virgen María, Madre de la Iglesia

verse.en: Now there stood by the cross of Jesus, his mother and his mother’s sister, Mary of Cleophas, and Mary Magdalen.
verse.web: But standing by Jesus’ cross were his mother, his mother’s sister, Mary the wife of Clopas, and Mary Magdalene.
verse.es: Estaban al mismo tiempo junto a la cruz de Jesús su madre, y la hermana o parienta de su madre, María muger de Cleophás, y María Magdalena.

verse.en: And they sent to him some of the Pharisees and of the Herodians: that they should catch him in his words.
verse.web: They sent some of the Pharisees and the Herodians to him, that they might trap him with words.
verse.es: Pero le enviaron algunos Fariseos y herodianos, para sorprenderle en alguna expresión.

verse.en: And there came to him the Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection.
verse.web: Some Sadducees, who say that there is no resurrection, came to him.
verse.es: Vinieron después a encontrarle los sadduceos que niegan la resurrección, y le propusieron esta cuestión: Maestro, Moysés nos dejó ordenado por escrito, que si el hermano de uno muere, dejando a su muger sin hijos…

verse.en: And there came one of the scribes that had heard them reasoning together, and seeing that he had answered them well, asked him which was the first commandment of all.
verse.web: One of the scribes came and heard them questioning together, and knowing that he had answered them well, asked him, “Which commandment is the greatest of all?”
verse.es: Uno de los Escribas, que había oído esta disputa, viendo lo bien que les había respondido, se arrimó, y le preguntó, cuál era el primero de todos los mandamientos.

verse.en: And Jesus answering, said, teaching in the temple: How do the scribes say that Christ is the son of David?
verse.web: Jesus responded, as he taught in the temple, “How is it that the scribes say that the Christ is the son of David?
verse.es: Y enseñando y razonando después Jesús en el Templo, decía: ¿Cómo dicen los Escribas que el Christo o Mesías es hijo de David?

verse.en: And he said to them in his doctrine: Beware of the scribes, who love to walk in long robes and to be saluted in the marketplace…
verse.web: In his teaching he said to them, “Beware of the scribes, who like to walk in long robes, and to get greetings in the marketplaces, and to get the best seats in the synagogues and the best places at feasts…
verse.es: Y decíales en sus instrucciones: Guardaos de los Escribas, que hacen gala de pasearse con vestidos rozagantes, y de ser saludados en la plaza, y de ocupar las primeras sillas en las synagogas…

verse.en: I have yet many things to say to you: but you cannot bear them now. But when he, the Spirit of truth, is come, he will teach you all truth.
verse.web: “I still have many things to tell you, but you can’t bear them now.
verse.es: Aún tengo otras muchas cosas que deciros; mas por ahora no podéis comprenderlas.

verse.en: And seeing the multitudes, he went up into a mountain, and when he was set down, his disciples came unto him.
verse.web: Seeing the multitudes, he went up onto the mountain. When he had sat down, his disciples came to him. He opened his mouth and taught them, saying, “Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.
verse.es: Mas viendo Jesús a todo este gentío, se subió a un monte, donde habiéndose sentado, se le acercaron sus discípulos, y abriendo su boca divina, los adoctrinaba diciendo: Bienaventurados los pobres de espíritu…

celebration.en: Saint Anthony of Padua, Priest and Doctor of the Church
celebration.es: San Antonio de Padua, presbítero y doctor de la Iglesia

verse.en: You are the salt of the earth. But if the salt lose its savour, wherewith shall it be salted? It is good for nothing anymore but to be cast out, and to be trodden on by men. You are the light of the world.
verse.web: “You are the salt of the earth, but if the salt has lost its flavor, with what will it be salted? It is then good for nothing, but to be cast out and trodden under the feet of men. “You are the light of the world.
verse.es: Vosotros sois la sal de la tierra. Y si la sal se hace insípida, ¿con qué se le volverá el sabor? para nada sirve ya, sino para ser arrojada y pisada de las gentes. Vosotros sois la luz del mundo.

verse.en: Do not think that I am come to destroy the law, or the prophets. I am not come to destroy, but to fulfil.
verse.web: “Don’t think that I came to destroy the law or the prophets. I didn’t come to destroy, but to fulfill.
verse.es: No penséis que yo he venido a destruir la doctrina de la Ley, ni de los Profetas: no he venido a destruirla, sino a darle su cumplimiento.

verse.en: For I tell you, that unless your justice abound more than that of the scribes and Pharisees, you shall not enter into the kingdom of heaven. You have heard that it was said to them of old: Thou shalt not kill.
verse.web: For I tell you that unless your righteousness exceeds that of the scribes and Pharisees, there is no way you will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven.
verse.es: Porque yo os digo, que si vuestra justicia no es más llena y mayor que la de los Escribas y Fariseos, no entraréis en el reino de los cielos.

verse.en: You have heard that it was said to them of old: Thou shalt not commit adultery. But I say to you, that whosoever shall look on a woman to lust after her, hath already committed adultery with her in his heart.
verse.web: “You have heard that it was said, ‘You shall not commit adultery;’ but I tell you that everyone who gazes at a woman to lust after her has committed adultery with her already in his heart.
verse.es: Habéis oído que se dijo a vuestros mayores: No cometerás adulterio. Yo os digo más: cualquiera que mirare a una muger con mal deseo acia ella, ya adulteró en su corazón.

verse.en: Again you have heard that it was said to them of old, thou shalt not forswear thyself: but thou shalt perform thy oaths to the Lord.
verse.web: “Again you have heard that it was said to the ancient ones, ‘You shall not make false vows, but shall perform to the Lord your vows,’ but I tell you, don’t swear at all: neither by heaven, for it is the throne of God…
verse.es: También habéis oído que se dijo a vuestros mayores; No jurarás en falso; antes bien cumplirás los juramentos hechos al Señor.

celebration.en: The Most Holy Body and Blood of Christ (Corpus Christi)
celebration.es: Santísimo Cuerpo y Sangre de Cristo (Corpus Christi)

verse.en: Which when the people knew, they followed him: and he received them and spoke to them of the kingdom of God and healed them who had need of healing. Now the day began to decline.
verse.web: But the multitudes, perceiving it, followed him. He welcomed them, spoke to them of God’s Kingdom, and he cured those who needed healing.
verse.es: Lo que sabido por los pueblos, se fueron tras él; y recibiolos Jesús con amor, y les hablaba del reino de Dios, y daba salud a los que carecían de ella. Empezaba a caer el día.

verse.en: You have heard that it hath been said: An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth.
verse.web: “You have heard that it was said, ‘An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth.’ But I tell you, don’t resist him who is evil; but whoever strikes you on your right cheek, turn to him the other also.
verse.es: Habéis oído que se dijo: Ojo por ojo, y diente por diente.

verse.en: You have heard that it hath been said, Thou shalt love thy neighbour, and hate thy enemy.
verse.web: “You have heard that it was said, ‘You shall love your neighbor and hate your enemy.’
verse.es: Habéis oído que fue dicho: Amarás a tu prójimo, y (han añadido malamente) tendrás odio a tu enemigo.

verse.en: Take heed that you do not your justice before men, to be seen by them: otherwise you shall not have a reward of your Father who is in heaven.
verse.web: “Be careful that you don’t do your charitable giving before men, to be seen by them, or else you have no reward from your Father who is in heaven.
verse.es: Guardaos bien de hacer vuestras obras buenas en presencia de los hombres, con el fin de que os vean: de otra manera no recibiréis su galardón de vuestro Padre, que está en los cielos.

verse.en: And when you are praying, speak not much, as the heathens. For they think that in their much speaking they may be heard.
verse.web: In praying, don’t use vain repetitions as the Gentiles do; for they think that they will be heard for their much speaking. Therefore don’t be like them, for your Father knows what things you need before you ask him.
verse.es: En la oración no afectéis hablar mucho, como hacen los gentiles, que se imaginan haber de ser oídos a fuerza de palabras. No queráis pues imitarlos; que bien sabe vuestro Padre lo que habéis menester, antes de pedírselo.

celebration.en: The Most Sacred Heart of Jesus

verse.en: And he spoke to them this parable, saying: What man of you that hath an hundred sheep, and if he shall lose one of them, doth he not leave the ninety-nine in the desert and go after that which was lost, until he find it?
verse.web: He told them this parable: “Which of you men, if you had one hundred sheep and lost one of them, wouldn’t leave the ninety-nine in the wilderness and go after the one that was lost, until he found it?
verse.es: Entonces les propuso esta parábola: ¿Quién hay de vosotros que, teniendo cien ovejas, y habiendo perdido una de ellas, no deje las noventa y nueve en la dehesa, y no vaya en busca de la que se perdió, hasta encontrarla?

celebration.en: The Nativity of Saint John the Baptist

verse.en: Now Elizabeth’s full time of being delivered was come: and she brought forth a son. And her neighbors and kinsfolks heard that the Lord had shewed his great mercy towards her: and they congratulated with her.
verse.web: Now the time that Elizabeth should give birth was fulfilled, and she gave birth to a son. Her neighbors and her relatives heard that the Lord had magnified his mercy toward her, and they rejoiced with her.
verse.es: Entre tanto le llegó a Elisabeth el tiempo de su alumbramiento, y dio a luz un hijo. Supieron sus vecinos y parientes la gran misericordia que Dios le había hecho, y se congratulaban con ella.

verse.en: And it came to pass, as he was alone praying, his disciples also were with him: and he asked them, saying: Whom do the people say that I am?
verse.web: As he was praying alone, the disciples were near him, and he asked them, “Who do the multitudes say that I am?”
verse.es: Sucedió un día, que habiéndose retirado a hacer oración, teniendo consigo a sus discípulos, preguntoles: ¿Quién dicen las gentes que soy yo?

verse.en: Judge not, that you may not be judged. For with what judgment you judge, you shall be judged: and with what measure you mete, it shall be measured to you again.
verse.web: “Don’t judge, so that you won’t be judged. For with whatever judgment you judge, you will be judged; and with whatever measure you measure, it will be measured to you.
verse.es: No juzguéis a los demás, si queréis no ser juzgados. Porque con el mismo juicio que juzgareis, habéis de ser juzgados; y con la misma medida con que midiereis, seréis medidos vosotros.

verse.en: Give not that which is holy to dogs; neither cast ye your pearls before swine, lest perhaps they trample them under their feet, and turning upon you, they tear you.
verse.web: “Don’t give that which is holy to the dogs, neither throw your pearls before the pigs, lest perhaps they trample them under their feet, and turn and tear you to pieces.
verse.es: No deis a los perros las cosas santas, ni echéis vuestras perlas a los cerdos, no sea que las huellen con sus pies, y se vuelvan contra vosotros y os despedazen.

celebration.en: Saint Irenaeus, Bishop, Martyr, and Doctor of the Church
celebration.es: San Ireneo, obispo, mártir y doctor de la Iglesia

verse.en: Beware of false prophets, who come to you in the clothing of sheep, but inwardly they are ravening wolves. By their fruits you shall know them. Do men gather grapes of thorns, or figs of thistles?
verse.web: “Beware of false prophets, who come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly are ravening wolves. By their fruits you will know them. Do you gather grapes from thorns or figs from thistles?
verse.es: Guardaos de los falsos profetas, que vienen a vosotros disfrazados con pieles de ovejas, mas por dentro son lobos voraces: por sus frutos u obras los conoceréis.

verse.en: And Jesus came into the quarters of Cesarea Philippi: and he asked his disciples, saying: Whom do men say that the Son of man is?
verse.web: Now when Jesus came into the parts of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, saying, “Who do men say that I, the Son of Man, am?”
verse.es: Viniendo después Jesús al territorio de Cesarea de Philippo, preguntó a sus discípulos: ¿Quién dicen los hombres que es el Hijo del hombre?

verse.en: And when he was come down from the mountain, great multitudes followed him: And behold a leper came and adored him, saying: Lord, if thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.
verse.web: When he came down from the mountain, great multitudes followed him. Behold, a leper came to him and worshiped him, saying, “Lord, if you want to, you can make me clean.”
verse.es: Habiendo bajado Jesús del monte, le fue siguiendo una gran muchedumbre de gentes: en esto, viniendo a él un leproso, le adoraba, diciendo: Señor, si tú quieres, puedes limpiarme.

verse.en: And when he had entered into Capharnaum, there came to him a centurion, beseeching him, And saying, Lord, my servant lieth at home sick of the palsy, and is grievously tormented.
verse.web: When he came into Capernaum, a centurion came to him, asking him for help, saying, “Lord, my servant lies in the house paralyzed, grievously tormented.” Jesus said to him, “I will come and heal him.”
verse.es: Y al entrar en Capharnaum, le salió al encuentro un centurión, y le rogaba, diciendo: Señor, un criado mío esta postrado en mi casa paralítico, y padece muchísimo. Dícele Jesús: Yo iré, y le curaré.

verse.en: And it came to pass, when the days of his assumption were accomplishing, that he steadfastly set his face to go to Jerusalem.
verse.web: It came to pass, when the days were near that he should be taken up, he intently set his face to go to Jerusalem and sent messengers before his face.
verse.es: Y cuando estaba para cumplirse el tiempo en que Jesús había de salir del mundo, se puso en camino, mostrando un semblante decidido para ir a Jerusalem, a consumar su sacrificio.

verse.en: Now Thomas, one of the twelve, who is called Didymus, was not with them when Jesus came. The other disciples therefore said to him: We have seen the Lord.
verse.web: But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, wasn’t with them when Jesus came. The other disciples therefore said to him, “We have seen the Lord!”
verse.es: Thomás empero, uno de los doce, llamado Dídymo, no estaba con ellos cuando vino Jesús. Dijéronle después los otros discípulos: Hemos visto al Señor.

verse.en: And when he entered into the boat, his disciples followed him: And behold a great tempest arose in the sea, so that the boat was covered with waves, but he was asleep.
verse.web: When he got into a boat, his disciples followed him. Behold, a violent storm came up on the sea, so much that the boat was covered with the waves; but he was asleep.
verse.es: Entró pues en una barca acompañado de sus discípulos; y he aquí que se levantó una tempestad tan recia en el mar, que las ondas cubrían la barca, mas Jesús estaba durmiendo.

verse.en: And when he was come on the other side of the water, into the country of the Gerasens, there met him two that were possessed with devils, coming out of the sepulchres, exceeding fierce…
verse.web: When he came to the other side, into the country of the Gergesenes, two people possessed by demons met him there, coming out of the tombs, exceedingly fierce, so that nobody could pass that way.
verse.es: Desembarcado en la otra ribera del lago en el país de los gerasenos, fueron al encuentro de él, saliendo de los sepulcros en que habitaban, dos endemoniados tan furiosos que nadie osaba transitar por aquel camino.

verse.en: And entering into a boat, he passed over the water and came into his own city. And behold they brought to him one sick of the palsy lying in a bed.
verse.web: He entered into a boat and crossed over, and came into his own city. Behold, they brought to him a man who was paralyzed, lying on a bed. Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic, “Son, cheer up!
verse.es: Y subiendo en la barca, repaso el lago, y vino a la ciudad de su residencia o a Capharnaum. Cuando he aquí que le presentaron un paralítico postrado en un lecho.

verse.en: And when Jesus passed on from thence, he saw a man sitting in the custom house, named Matthew; and he saith to him: Follow me. And he arose up and followed him.
verse.web: As Jesus passed by from there, he saw a man called Matthew sitting at the tax collection office. He said to him, “Follow me.” He got up and followed him.
verse.es: Partido de aquí Jesús, vio a un hombre sentado al banco o mesa de las alcabalas, llamado Matheo. Y le dijo: Sígueme. Y él levantándose luego, le siguió.

verse.en: Then came to him the disciples of John, saying: Why do we and the Pharisees, fast often, but thy disciples do not fast?
verse.web: Then John’s disciples came to him, saying, “Why do we and the Pharisees fast often, but your disciples don’t fast?” Jesus said to them, “Can the friends of the bridegroom mourn as long as the bridegroom is with them?
verse.es: Entonces se presentaron a Jesús los discípulos de Juan, y le dijeron: ¿Cuál es el motivo por que, ayunando frecuentemente nosotros y los Fariseos, tus discípulos no ayunan?

verse.en: And after these things, the Lord appointed also other seventy-two. And he sent them two and two before his face into every city and place whither he himself was to come.
verse.web: Now after these things, the Lord also appointed seventy others, and sent them two by two ahead of him into every city and place where he was about to come.
verse.es: Después de esto eligió el Señor otros setenta y dos discípulos, a los cuales envió delante de él, de dos en dos, por todas las ciudades, y lugares a donde había de venir él mismo.

verse.en: As he was speaking these things unto them, behold a certain ruler came up, and adored him, saying: Lord, my daughter is even now dead; but come, lay thy hand upon her, and she shall live.
verse.web: While he told these things to them, behold, a ruler came and worshiped him, saying, “My daughter has just died, but come and lay your hand on her, and she will live.” Jesus got up and followed him, as did his disciples.
verse.es: En esta conversación estaba, cuando llegó un hombre principal o gefe de synagoga, y adorándole, le dijo: Señor, una hija mía está a punto de morir; pero ven, impón tu mano sobre ella, y vivirá.

verse.en: And when they were gone out, behold they brought him a dumb man, possessed with a devil. And after the devil was cast out, the dumb man spoke, and the multitudes wondered, saying, Never was the like seen in Israel.
verse.web: As they went out, behold, a mute man who was demon possessed was brought to him. When the demon was cast out, the mute man spoke. The multitudes marveled, saying, “Nothing like this has ever been seen in Israel!”
verse.es: Salidos estos, le presentaron un mudo, endemoniado. Y arrojado el demonio, habló el mudo, y las gentes se llenaron de admiración, y decían: Jamás se ha visto cosa semejante en Israel.

verse.en: And having called his twelve disciples together, he gave them power over unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal all manner of diseases, and all manner of infirmities.
verse.web: He called to himself his twelve disciples, and gave them authority over unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal every disease and every sickness. Now the names of the twelve apostles are these.
verse.es: Después de esto, habiendo convocado a sus doce discípulos, les dio potestad para lanzar los espíritus inmundos, y curar toda especie de dolencias, y enfermedades. Los nombres de los doce apóstoles son estos.

verse.en: And going, preach, saying: The kingdom of heaven is at hand. Heal the sick, raise the dead, cleanse the lepers, cast out devils: freely have you received, freely give.
verse.web: As you go, preach, saying, ‘The Kingdom of Heaven is at hand!’ Heal the sick, cleanse the lepers, and cast out demons. Freely you received, so freely give. Don’t take any gold, silver, or brass in your money belts.
verse.es: y predicad, diciendo: Que se acerca el reino de los cielos. Y, en prueba de vuestra doctrina, curad enfermos, resucitad muertos, limpiad leprosos, lanzad demonios: dad graciosamente lo que graciosamente habéis recibido.

verse.en: Behold I send you as sheep in the midst of wolves. Be ye therefore wise as serpents and simple as doves. But beware of men. For they will deliver you up in councils, and they will scourge you in their synagogues.
verse.web: “Behold, I send you out as sheep among wolves. Therefore be wise as serpents and harmless as doves. But beware of men, for they will deliver you up to councils, and in their synagogues they will scourge you.
verse.es: Mirad que yo os envío como ovejas en medio de lobos. Por tanto habéis de ser prudentes como serpientes, y sencillos como palomas. Recataos empero de los tales hombres.

celebration.en: Saint Bonaventure, Bishop and Doctor of the Church
celebration.es: San Buenaventura, obispo y doctor de la Iglesia

verse.en: The disciple is not above the master, nor the servant above his lord. It is enough for the disciple that he be as his master, and the servant as his lord.
verse.web: “A disciple is not above his teacher, nor a servant above his lord. It is enough for the disciple that he be like his teacher, and the servant like his lord.
verse.es: No es el discípulo más que su maestro, ni el siervo más que su amo: baste al discípulo, el ser tratado como su maestro; y al criado, como su amo.

verse.en: And behold a certain lawyer stood up, tempting him and saying, Master, what must I do to possess eternal life? But he said to him: What is written in the law? How readest thou?
verse.web: Behold, a certain lawyer stood up and tested him, saying, “Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?” He said to him, “What is written in the law? How do you read it?”
verse.es: Levantose entonces un doctor de la Ley, y díjole con el fin de tentarle: Maestro, ¿qué debo yo hacer para conseguir la vida eterna? Díjole Jesús: ¿Qué es lo que se halla escrito en la Ley? ¿qué es lo que en ella lees?

verse.en: Do not think that I came to send peace upon earth: I came not to send peace, but the sword.
verse.web: “Don’t think that I came to send peace on the earth. I didn’t come to send peace, but a sword.
verse.es: No tenéis que pensar que yo haya venido a traer la paz a la tierra: no he venido a traer la paz, sino la guerra; pues he venido a separar al hijo de su padre, y a la hija de su madre, y a la nuera de su suegra…

verse.en: Then began he to upbraid the cities wherein were done the most of his miracles, for that they had not done penance.
verse.web: Then he began to denounce the cities in which most of his mighty works had been done, because they didn’t repent. “Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida!
verse.es: Entonces comenzó a reconvenir a las ciudades donde se habían hecho muchísimos de sus milagros, porque no habían hecho penitencia. ¡Ay de ti, Corozain! ¡ay de ti, Bethsaida!

verse.en: At that time Jesus answered and said: I confess to thee, O Father, Lord of Heaven and earth, because thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent, and hast revealed them to little ones.
verse.web: At that time, Jesus answered, “I thank you, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that you hid these things from the wise and understanding, and revealed them to infants.
verse.es: Por aquel tiempo exclamó Jesús diciendo: Yo te glorifico, Padre mío, señor de cielo y tierra, porque has tenido encubiertas estas cosas a los sabios y prudentes del siglo y las has revelado los pequeñuelos.

verse.en: Come to me all you that labor and are burdened, and I will refresh you. Take up my yoke upon you, and learn of me, because I am meek, and humble of heart: And you shall find rest to your souls.
verse.web: “Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest. Take my yoke upon you and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart; and you will find rest for your souls.
verse.es: Venid a mí todos los que andáis agobiados con trabajos y cargas, que yo os aliviaré. Tomad mi yugo sobre vosotros, y aprended de mí, que soy manso y humilde de corazón; y hallaréis el reposo para vuestras almas.

verse.en: At that time Jesus went through the corn on the sabbath: and his disciples being hungry, began to pluck the ears, and to eat.
verse.web: At that time, Jesus went on the Sabbath day through the grain fields. His disciples were hungry and began to pluck heads of grain and to eat.
verse.es: Por aquel tiempo pasando Jesús en el día de sábado por junto a unos sembrados, sus discípulos teniendo hambre, empezaron a coger espigas, y comer los granos.

verse.en: And on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalen cometh early, when it was yet dark, unto the sepulchre: and she saw the stone taken away from the sepulchre.
verse.web: Now on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene went early, while it was still dark, to the tomb, and saw that the stone had been taken away from the tomb.
verse.es: El primer día de la semana, al amanecer, cuando todavía estaba oscuro, fue María Magdalena al sepulcro, y vio quitada de él la piedra.

verse.en: Now it came to pass, as they went, that he entered into a certain town: and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house.
verse.web: As they went on their way, he entered into a certain village, and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house. She had a sister called Mary, who also sat at Jesus’ feet and heard his word.
verse.es: Prosiguiendo Jesús su viage a Jerusalem, entró en cierta aldea, donde una muger, por nombre Martha, le hospedó en su casa: tenía esta una hermana llamada María…

verse.en: Then some of the scribes and Pharisees answered him, saying: Master, we would see a sign from thee.
verse.web: Then certain of the scribes and Pharisees answered, “Teacher, we want to see a sign from you.”
verse.es: Entonces algunos de los Escribas y Fariseos le hablaron, diciendo: Maestro, quisiéramos verte hacer algún milagro.

verse.en: Then came to him the mother of the sons of Zebedee with her sons, adoring and asking something of him. Who said to her: What wilt thou?
verse.web: Then the mother of the sons of Zebedee came to him with her sons, kneeling and asking a certain thing of him. He said to her, “What do you want?”
verse.es: Entonces la madre de los hijos de Zebedeo se le acerca con sus dos hijos, y le adora, manifestando querer pedirle alguna gracia. Jesús le dijo: ¿Qué quieres?

celebration.en: Saints Joachim and Anne, Parents of the Blessed Virgin Mary
celebration.es: Santos Joaquín y Ana, padres de la Bienaventurada Virgen María

verse.en: The same day Jesus going out of the house, sat by the sea side. And great multitudes were gathered together unto him, so that he went up into a boat and sat: and all the multitude stood on the shore.
verse.web: On that day Jesus went out of the house and sat by the seaside. Great multitudes gathered to him, so that he entered into a boat and sat; and all the multitude stood on the beach.
verse.es: En aquel día saliendo Jesús de casa, fue y sentose a la orilla del mar.

verse.en: And his disciples came and said to him: Why speakest thou to them in parables? Who answered and said to them: Because to you it is given to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven: but to them it is not given.
verse.web: The disciples came, and said to him, “Why do you speak to them in parables?” He answered them, “To you it is given to know the mysteries of the Kingdom of Heaven, but it is not given to them.
verse.es: Acercándose después sus discípulos le preguntaban: Por que causa les hablas por parábolas?

verse.en: Hear you therefore the parable of the sower.
verse.web: “Hear, then, the parable of the farmer. When anyone hears the word of the Kingdom and doesn’t understand it, the evil one comes and snatches away that which has been sown in his heart.
verse.es: Escuchad ahora la parábola del sembrador.

verse.en: And many of the Jews were come to Martha and Mary, to comfort them concerning their brother. Martha therefore, as soon as she heard that Jesus was come, went to meet him: but Mary sat at home.
verse.web: Many of the Jews had joined the women around Martha and Mary, to console them concerning their brother. Then when Martha heard that Jesus was coming, she went and met him, but Mary stayed in the house.
verse.es: Y habían ido muchos de los judíos a consolar a Martha y a María de la muerte de su hermano. Martha luego que oyó que Jesús venía, le salió a recibir; y María se quedó en casa.

verse.en: And it came to pass that as he was in a certain place praying, when he ceased, one of his disciples said to him: Lord, teach us to pray, as John also taught his disciples.
verse.web: When he finished praying in a certain place, one of his disciples said to him, “Lord, teach us to pray, just as John also taught his disciples.”
verse.es: Un día estando Jesús orando en cierto lugar, acabada la oración, díjole uno de sus discípulos: Señor, enséñanos a orar, como enseñó también Juan a sus discípulos.

verse.en: Another parable he proposed unto them, saying: The kingdom of heaven is like to a grain of mustard seed, which a man took and sowed in his field.
verse.web: He set another parable before them, saying, “The Kingdom of Heaven is like a grain of mustard seed which a man took, and sowed in his field, which indeed is smaller than all seeds.
verse.es: Propúsoles otra parábola diciendo: El reino de los cielos es semejante al grano de mostaza, que tomó en su mano un hombre, y le sembró en su campo, el cual es a la vista menudísimo entre todas las semillas…

celebration.en: Saint Alphonsus Liguori, Bishop and Doctor of the Church
celebration.es: San Alfonso María de Ligorio, obispo y doctor de la Iglesia

verse.en: Then having sent away the multitudes, he came into the house, and his disciples came to him, saying: Expound to us the parable of the cockle of the field.
verse.web: Then Jesus sent the multitudes away, and went into the house. His disciples came to him, saying, “Explain to us the parable of the darnel weeds of the field.”
verse.es: Entonces Jesús, despedido el auditorio, volvió a casa; y rodeándole sus discípulos, le dijeron: Esplícanos la parábola de la zizaña sembrada en el campo.

verse.en: The kingdom of heaven is like unto a treasure hidden in a field. Which a man having found, hid it, and for joy thereof goeth, and selleth all that he hath, and buyeth that field.
verse.web: “Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like treasure hidden in the field, which a man found and hid. In his joy, he goes and sells all that he has and buys that field.
verse.es: Es también semejante el reino de los cielos a un tesoro escondido en el campo, que si lo halla un hombre, lo encubre de nuevo, y gozoso del hallazgo va, y vende todo cuanto tiene, y compra aquel campo.

verse.en: Again the kingdom of heaven is like to a net cast into the sea, and gathering together of all kinds of fishes.
verse.web: “Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like a dragnet that was cast into the sea and gathered some fish of every kind, which, when it was filled, fishermen drew up on the beach.
verse.es: También es semejante el reino de los cielos a una red barredera, que echada en el mar allega todo género de peces: la cual, en estando llena, sácanla los pescadores y sentados en la orilla…

verse.en: And coming into his own country, he taught them in their synagogues, so that they wondered and said: How came this man by this wisdom and miracles? Is not this the carpenter’s son?
verse.web: Coming into his own country, he taught them in their synagogue, so that they were astonished and said, “Where did this man get this wisdom and these mighty works? Isn’t this the carpenter’s son?
verse.es: Y pasando a su patria, se puso a enseñar en las synagogas de sus naturales, de tal manera que no cesaban de maravillarse, y se decían: ¿De dónde le ha venido a este tal sabiduría, y tales milagros?

verse.en: At that time Herod the Tetrarch heard the fame of Jesus. And he said to his servants: This is John the Baptist: he is risen from the dead, and therefore mighty works shew forth themselves in him.
verse.web: At that time, Herod the tetrarch heard the report concerning Jesus, and said to his servants, “This is John the Baptizer. He is risen from the dead. That is why these powers work in him.”
verse.es: Por aquel tiempo Herodes el tetrarchà oyó lo que la fama publicaba de Jesús, y dijo a sus cortesanos: Este es Juan el Bautista, que ha resucitado de entre los muertos…

verse.en: And it came to pass, about eight days after these words, that he took Peter and James and John and went up into a mountain to pray.
verse.web: About eight days after these sayings, he took with him Peter, John, and James, and went up onto the mountain to pray. As he was praying, the appearance of his face was altered, and his clothing became white and dazzling.
verse.es: Sucedió pues, que cerca de ocho días después de dichas estas palabras, tomó consigo a Pedro, y a Santiago, y a Juan, y subió a un monte a orar.

verse.en: Which when Jesus had heard, he retired from thence by a boat, into a desert place apart, and the multitudes having heard of it, followed him on foot out of the cities.
verse.web: Now when Jesus heard this, he withdrew from there in a boat to a deserted place apart. When the multitudes heard it, they followed him on foot from the cities. Jesus went out, and he saw a great multitude.
verse.es: Jesús pues habiendo oído aquello que Herodes decía de él, retirose de allí por mar a un lugar desierto, fuera de poblado; mas entendiéndolo las gentes, salieron de sus ciudades, siguiéndole a pie por tierra.

verse.en: And forthwith Jesus obliged his disciples to go up into the boat, and to go before him over the water, till he dismissed the people. And having dismissed the multitude, he went into a mountain alone to pray.
verse.web: Immediately Jesus made the disciples get into the boat and go ahead of him to the other side, while he sent the multitudes away. After he had sent the multitudes away, he went up into the mountain by himself to pray.
verse.es: Inmediatamente después Jesús obligó a sus discípulos a embarcarse, e ir a esperarle al otro lado del lago, mientras que despedía a los pueblos.

verse.en: And Jesus went from thence, and retired into the coasts of Tyre and Sidon.
verse.web: Jesus went out from there and withdrew into the region of Tyre and Sidon. Behold, a Canaanite woman came out from those borders and cried, saying, “Have mercy on me, Lord, you son of David!
verse.es: Partido de aquí Jesús, retirose acia el país de Tyro y de Sidon.

verse.en: Amen, amen, I say to you, unless the grain of wheat falling into the ground die, Itself remaineth alone. But if it die it bringeth forth much fruit.
verse.web: Most certainly I tell you, unless a grain of wheat falls into the earth and dies, it remains by itself alone. But if it dies, it bears much fruit. He who loves his life will lose it.
verse.es: En verdad, en verdad os digo, que si el grano de trigo, después de echado en la tierra, no muere, queda infecundo; pero si muere, produce mucho fruto.

verse.en: Then Jesus said to his disciples: If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.
verse.web: Then Jesus said to his disciples, “If anyone desires to come after me, let him deny himself, take up his cross, and follow me.
verse.es: Entonces dijo Jesús a sus discípulos: Si alguno quiere venir en pos de mí, niéguese a sí mismo, y cargue con su cruz, y sígame.

verse.en: And when he was come to the multitude, there came to him a man falling down on his knees before him saying: Lord, have pity on my son, for he is a lunatic, and suffereth much: for he falleth often into the fire…
verse.web: When they came to the multitude, a man came to him, kneeling down to him and saying, “Lord, have mercy on my son, for he is epileptic and suffers grievously; for he often falls into the fire, and often into the water.
verse.es: Llegado al lugar donde le aguardaban las gentes, vino un hombre, e hincadas las rodillas delante de él, le dijo: Señor, ten compasión de mi hijo, porque es lunático, y padece mucho; pues muy a menudo cae en el fuego…

verse.en: Fear not, little flock, for it hath pleased your Father to give you a kingdom. Sell what you possess and give alms.
verse.web: “Don’t be afraid, little flock, for it is your Father’s good pleasure to give you the Kingdom. Sell what you have and give gifts to the needy.
verse.es: No tenéis vosotros que temer, mi pequeñito rebaño, porque ha sido del agrado de vuestro Padre celestial daros el reino eterno. Vended, si es necesario, lo que poseéis, y dad limosna.

celebration.en: Saint Maximilian Kolbe, Priest and Martyr
celebration.es: San Maximiliano María Kolbe, presbítero y mártir

verse.en: And when they abode together in Galilee, Jesus said to them: The Son of man shall be betrayed into the hands of men: And they shall kill him, and the third day he shall rise again. And they were troubled exceedingly.
verse.web: While they were staying in Galilee, Jesus said to them, “The Son of Man is about to be delivered up into the hands of men, and they will kill him, and the third day he will be raised up.” They were exceedingly sorry.
verse.es: Mientras estaban ellos en Galilea, díjoles nuevamente Jesús: El Hijo del hombre ha de ser entregado en manos de los hombres. Y le matarán, y resucitará al tercer día. Con lo cual los discípulos se afligieron sobremanera.

celebration.en: The Assumption of the Blessed Virgin Mary
celebration.es: Asunción de la Bienaventurada Virgen María

verse.en: And Mary rising up in those days, went into the hill country with haste into a city of Juda. And she entered into the house of Zachary and saluted Elizabeth.
verse.web: Mary arose in those days and went into the hill country with haste, into a city of Judah, and entered into the house of Zacharias and greeted Elizabeth.
verse.es: Por aquellos días partió María, y se fue apresuradamente a las montañas de Judea a una ciudad de la tribu de Judá; y habiendo entrado en la casa de Zachârías, saludó a Elisabeth.

verse.en: But if thy brother shall offend against thee, go, and rebuke him between thee and him alone. If he shall hear thee, thou shalt gain thy brother.
verse.web: “If your brother sins against you, go, show him his fault between you and him alone. If he listens to you, you have gained back your brother.
verse.es: Que si tu hermano pecare contra ti, o cayere en alguna culpa, ve y corrígele estando a solas con el: si te escucha, habrás ganado a tu hermano: si no hiciere caso de ti, todavía válete de una o dos personas…

verse.en: Then came Peter unto him and said: Lord, how often shall my brother offend against me, and I forgive him? till seven times? Jesus saith to him: I say not to thee, till seven times; but till seventy times seven times.
verse.web: Then Peter came and said to him, “Lord, how often shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? Until seven times?” Jesus said to him, “I don’t tell you until seven times, but, until seventy times seven.
verse.es: En esta sazón, arrimándosele Pedro, le dijo: Señor, ¿cuántas veces deberé perdonar a mi hermano, cuando pecare contra mi? ¿hasta siete veces?

verse.en: And there came to him the Pharisees tempting him, saying: Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife for every cause?
verse.web: Pharisees came to him, testing him and saying, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife for any reason?”
verse.es: Y se llegaron a él los Fariseos para tentarle, y le dijeron: ¿Es lícito a un hombre repudiar a su muger por cualquier motivo?

verse.en: Then were little children presented to him, that he should impose hands upon them and pray. And the disciples rebuked them.
verse.web: Then little children were brought to him that he should lay his hands on them and pray; and the disciples rebuked them.
verse.es: En esta sazón le presentaron unos niños para que pusiese sobre ellos las manos, y orase. Mas los discípulos creyendo que le importunaban, les reñían.

verse.en: I am come to cast fire on the earth. And what will I, but that it be kindled? And I have a baptism wherewith I am to be baptized. And how am I straitened until it be accomplished?
verse.web: “I came to throw fire on the earth. I wish it were already kindled. But I have a baptism to be baptized with, and how distressed I am until it is accomplished! Do you think that I have come to give peace on the earth?
verse.es: Yo he venido a poner fuego en la tierra, ¿y qué he de querer sino que arda? Con un bautismo de sangre tengo de ser yo bautizado: ¡oh y cómo traigo en prensa el corazón, mientras que no lo veo cumplido!

verse.en: And behold one came and said to him: Good master, what good shall I do that I may have life everlasting? Who said to him: Why askest thou me concerning good? One is good, God.
verse.web: Behold, one came to him and said, “Good teacher, what good thing shall I do, that I may have eternal life?” He said to him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good but one, that is, God.
verse.es: Acercósele entonces un hombre joven que le dijo: Maestro bueno, ¿qué obras buenas debo hacer para conseguir la vida eterna? El cual le respondió: ¿Por qué me llamas bueno? Dios solo es el bueno.

celebration.en: The Queenship of the Blessed Virgin Mary

verse.en: Then Jesus said to his disciples: Amen, I say to you, that a rich man shall hardly enter into the kingdom of heaven.
verse.web: Jesus said to his disciples, “Most certainly I say to you, a rich man will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven with difficulty.
verse.es: Jesús dijo entonces a sus discípulos: En verdad os digo, que difícilmente un rico entrará en el reino de los cielos.

verse.en: The kingdom of heaven is like to an householder, who went out early in the morning to hire labourers into his vineyard. And having agreed with the labourers for a penny a day, he sent them into his vineyard.
verse.web: “For the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who was the master of a household, who went out early in the morning to hire laborers for his vineyard.
verse.es: Porque el reino de los cielos se parece a un padre de familias, que al romper el día salió a alquilar jornaleros para su viña, y ajustándose con ellos en un denario por día, enviolos a su viña.

verse.en: Philip findeth Nathanael and saith to him: We have found him of whom Moses, in the law and the prophets did write, Jesus the son of Joseph of Nazareth. And Nathanael said to him: Can any thing of good come from Nazareth?
verse.web: Philip found Nathanael, and said to him, “We have found him of whom Moses in the law and also the prophets, wrote: Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.” Nathanael said to him, “Can any good thing come out of Nazareth?”
verse.es: Phelippe halló a Nathanael, y le dijo: Hemos encontrado a aquel de quien escribió Moysés en la Ley, y prenunciaron los Profetas, a Jesús de Nazareth, el hijo de Joseph.

verse.en: But the Pharisees, hearing that he had silenced the Sadducees, came together. And one of them, a doctor of the law, asked him, tempting him: Master, which is the great commandment in the law?
verse.web: But the Pharisees, when they heard that he had silenced the Sadducees, gathered themselves together. One of them, a lawyer, asked him a question, testing him. “Teacher, which is the greatest commandment in the law?”
verse.es: Pero los Fariseos, informados de que había tapado la boca a los sadduceos, se mancomunaron; y uno de ellos, doctor de la ley, le preguntó para tentarle: Maestro, ¿cuál es el mandamiento principal de la Ley?

verse.en: Then Jesus spoke to the multitudes and to his disciples, Saying: The scribes and the Pharisees have sitten on the chair of Moses.
verse.web: Then Jesus spoke to the multitudes and to his disciples, saying, “The scribes and the Pharisees sit on Moses’ seat.
verse.es: Entonces dirigiendo Jesús su palabra al pueblo, y a sus discípulos, les dijo: Los Escribas, o doctores de la Ley, y los Fariseos están sentados en la cátedra de Moysés.

verse.en: And he went through the cities and towns teaching and making his journey to Jerusalem. And a certain man said to him: Lord, are they few that are saved?
verse.web: He went on his way through cities and villages, teaching, and traveling on to Jerusalem. One said to him, “Lord, are they few who are saved?”
verse.es: E iba así enseñando por las ciudades y aldeas, de camino para Jerusalem. Y uno le preguntó: Señor, ¿es verdad que son pocos los que se salvan?

celebration.en: Saint Augustine, Bishop and Doctor of the Church
celebration.es: San Agustín, obispo y doctor de la Iglesia

verse.en: But woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites, because you shut the kingdom of heaven against men: for you yourselves do not enter in and those that are going in, you suffer not to enter.
verse.web: “But woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! Because you shut up the Kingdom of Heaven against men; for you don’t enter in yourselves, neither do you allow those who are entering in to enter.
verse.es: Pero ¡ay de vosotros, Escribas y Fariseos hipócritas! que cerráis el reino de los cielos a los hombres; porque ni vosotros entráis, ni dejáis entrar a los que entrarían, impidiéndoles que crean en mí.

celebration.en: The Passion of Saint John the Baptist

verse.en: For Herod himself had sent and apprehended John, and bound him in prison for the sake of Herodias the wife of Philip his brother, because he had married her.
verse.web: For Herod himself had sent out and arrested John and bound him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife, for he had married her.
verse.es: Porque es de saber que el dicho Herodes había enviado a prender a Juan, y le aherrojó en la cárcel por amor de Herodías, muger de su hermano Philippo, con la cual se había casado.

verse.en: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites; because you are like to whited sepulchres, which outwardly appear to men beautiful but within are full of dead men’s bones and of all filthiness.
verse.web: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you are like whitened tombs, which outwardly appear beautiful, but inwardly are full of dead men’s bones and of all uncleanness.
verse.es: ¡Ay de vosotros, Escribas y Fariseos hipócritas!

verse.en: Watch ye therefore, because you know not what hour your Lord will come.
verse.web: Watch therefore, for you don’t know in what hour your Lord comes.
verse.es: Velad pues vosotros, ya que no sabéis a qué hora ha de venir vuestro Señor.

verse.en: Then shall the kingdom of heaven be like to ten virgins, who taking their lamps went out to meet the bridegroom and the bride. And five of them were foolish and five wise.
verse.web: “Then the Kingdom of Heaven will be like ten virgins who took their lamps and went out to meet the bridegroom. Five of them were foolish, and five were wise.
verse.es: Entonces el reino de los cielos será semejante a diez vírgenes, que tomando sus lámparas, salieron a recibir al esposo y a la esposa.

verse.en: For even as a man going into a far country called his servants and delivered to them his goods; And to one he gave five talents, and to another two, and to another one, to every one according to his proper ability…
verse.web: “For it is like a man going into another country, who called his own servants and entrusted his goods to them. To one he gave five talents, to another two, to another one, to each according to his own ability.
verse.es: Porque el Señor obrará como un hombre que yéndose a lejas tierras, convocó a sus criados, y les entregó sus bienes, dando al uno cinco talentos, a otro dos, y uno solo a otro, a cada uno según su capacidad…

verse.en: And it came to pass, when Jesus went into the house of one of the chief of the Pharisees, on the sabbath day, to eat bread, that they watched him.
verse.web: When he went into the house of one of the rulers of the Pharisees on a Sabbath to eat bread, they were watching him.
verse.es: Y sucedió que habiendo entrado Jesús en casa de uno de los principales Fariseos a comer en un día de sábado, le estaban estos acechando.

verse.en: And he came to Nazareth, where he was brought up: and he went into the synagogue, according to his custom, on the sabbath day: and he rose up to read. And the book of Isaias the prophet was delivered unto him.
verse.web: He came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up. He entered, as was his custom, into the synagogue on the Sabbath day, and stood up to read. The book of the prophet Isaiah was handed to him.
verse.es: Habiendo ido a Nazareth, donde se había criado, entró, según su costumbre, el día de sábado en la synagoga, y se levantó para encargarse de la leyenda e interpretación. Fuele dado el Libro del Profeta Isaías.

verse.en: And he went down into Capharnaum, a city of Galilee: and there he taught them on the sabbath days. And they were astonished at his doctrine: for his speech was with power.
verse.web: He came down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee. He was teaching them on the Sabbath day, and they were astonished at his teaching, for his word was with authority.
verse.es: Y bajó a Capharnaum, ciudad de Galilea, donde enseñaba al pueblo en los días de sábado. Y estaban asombrados de su doctrina, porque su modo de predicar era de gran autoridad y poderío.

verse.en: And Jesus rising up out of the synagogue, went into Simon’s house. And Simon’s wife’s mother was taken with a great fever: and they besought him for her. And standing over her, he commanded the fever: and it left her.
verse.web: He rose up from the synagogue and entered into Simon’s house. Simon’s mother-in-law was afflicted with a great fever, and they begged him to help her. He stood over her and rebuked the fever, and it left her.
verse.es: Y saliendo Jesús de la synagoga, entró en casa de Simón. Hallábase la suegra de Simón con una fuerte calentura; y suplicáronle por su alivio.

verse.en: And it came to pass, that when the multitudes pressed upon him to hear the word of God, he stood by the lake of Genesareth, And saw two ships standing by the lake…
verse.web: Now while the multitude pressed on him and heard the word of God, he was standing by the lake of Gennesaret. He saw two boats standing by the lake, but the fishermen had gone out of them and were washing their nets.
verse.es: Sucedió un día, que hallándose Jesús junto al lago de Genesareth, las gentes se agolpaban al rededor de él, ansiosas de oír la palabra de Dios.

celebration.en: The Nativity of the Blessed Virgin Mary
celebration.es: Natividad de la Bienaventurada Virgen María

verse.en: The book of the generation of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham: Abraham begot Isaac. And Isaac begot Jacob. And Jacob begot Judas and his brethren. And Judas begot Phares and Zara of Thamar.
verse.web: The book of the genealogy of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham. Abraham became the father of Isaac. Isaac became the father of Jacob. Jacob became the father of Judah and his brothers.
verse.es: Genealogía de Jesu-Christo, hijo de David, hijo de Abraham. Abraham engendró a Isaac. Isaac engendró a Jacob. Jacob engendró a Judas, y a sus hermanos. Judas engendró de Thamar a Pharés y a Zara. Pharés engendró a Esrón.

verse.en: And it came to pass on the second first sabbath that, as he went through the corn fields, his disciples plucked the ears and did eat, rubbing them in their hands.
verse.web: Now on the second Sabbath after the first, he was going through the grain fields. His disciples plucked the heads of grain and ate, rubbing them in their hands.
verse.es: Aconteció también en el sábado, llamado segundo-primero, que pasando Jesús por junto a unos sembrados, sus discípulos arrancaban espigas, y estregándolas entre las manos, comían los granos.

verse.en: And there went great multitudes with him.
verse.web: Now great multitudes were going with him.
verse.es: Sucedió que yendo con Jesús gran multitud de gentes, vuelto a ellas les dijo: Si alguno de los que me siguen, no aborrece, o no ama menos que a mí, a su padre y madre, y a la muger, y a los hijos…

verse.en: And it came to pass also, on another sabbath, that he entered into the synagogue and taught. And there was a man whose right hand was withered.
verse.web: It also happened on another Sabbath that he entered into the synagogue and taught. There was a man there, and his right hand was withered.
verse.es: Sucedió que Entró otro sábado en la synagoga, y púsose a enseñar. Hallábase allí un hombre, que tenía seca la mano derecha.

verse.en: And it came to pass in those days, that he went out into a mountain to pray: and he passed the whole night in the prayer of God.
verse.web: In these days, he went out to the mountain to pray, and he continued all night in prayer to God.
verse.es: Por este tiempo se retiró a orar en un monte, y pasó toda la noche haciendo oración a Dios.

celebration.en: Saint John Chrysostom, Bishop and Doctor of the Church
celebration.es: San Juan Crisóstomo, obispo y doctor de la Iglesia

verse.en: And he, lifting up his eyes on his disciples, said: Blessed are ye poor: for yours is the kingdom of God. Blessed are ye that hunger now: for you shall be filled. Blessed are ye that weep now: for you shall laugh.
verse.web: He lifted up his eyes to his disciples, and said: “Blessed are you who are poor, for God’s Kingdom is yours. Blessed are you who hunger now, for you will be filled. Blessed are you who weep now, for you will laugh.
verse.es: Entonces levantando los ojos acia sus discípulos, decía: Bienaventurados vosotros los pobres, porque vuestro es el reino de Dios. Bienaventurados los que ahora tenéis hambre, porque seréis saciados.

celebration.en: The Exaltation of the Holy Cross

verse.en: And no man hath ascended into heaven, but he that descended from heaven, the Son of man who is in heaven.
verse.web: No one has ascended into heaven but he who descended out of heaven, the Son of Man, who is in heaven.
verse.es: Ello es así que nadie subió al cielo, sino aquel que ha descendido del cielo, a saber, el Hijo del hombre, que está en el cielo.

celebration.es: Bienaventurada Virgen María de los Dolores

verse.en: Now there stood by the cross of Jesus, his mother and his mother’s sister, Mary of Cleophas, and Mary Magdalen.
verse.web: But standing by Jesus’ cross were his mother, his mother’s sister, Mary the wife of Clopas, and Mary Magdalene.
verse.es: Estaban al mismo tiempo junto a la cruz de Jesús su madre, y la hermana o parienta de su madre, María muger de Cleophás, y María Magdalena.

celebration.en: Saints Cornelius, Pope, and Cyprian, Bishop, Martyrs
celebration.es: Santos Cornelio, Papa, y Cipriano, obispo, mártires

verse.en: For there is no good tree that bringeth forth evil fruit: nor an evil tree that bringeth forth good fruit. For every tree is known by its fruit.
verse.web: “For there is no good tree that produces rotten fruit, nor again a rotten tree that produces good fruit. For each tree is known by its own fruit.
verse.es: Porque no es árbol bueno, el que da malos frutos, ni árbol malo el que da frutos buenos. Pues cada árbol por su fruto se conoce. Que no se cogen higos de los espinos, ni de las zarzas racimos de uvas.

verse.en: Now the publicans and sinners drew near unto him to hear him. And the Pharisees and the scribes murmured, saying: This man receiveth sinners and eateth with them.
verse.web: Now all the tax collectors and sinners were coming close to him to hear him. The Pharisees and the scribes murmured, saying, “This man welcomes sinners, and eats with them.”
verse.es: Solían los publicanos, y pecadores acercarse a Jesús para oírle. Y los Fariseos y Escribas murmuraban de eso diciendo: Mirad cómo se familiariza con los pecadores, y come con ellos.

verse.en: And when he had finished all his words in the hearing of the people, he entered into Capharnaum. And the servant of a certain centurion who was dear to him, being sick, was ready to die.
verse.web: After he had finished speaking in the hearing of the people, he entered into Capernaum. A certain centurion’s servant, who was dear to him, was sick and at the point of death.
verse.es: Concluida toda su plática al pueblo que le escuchaba, entró en Capharnaum. Hallábase allí a la sazón un centurión que tenía enfermo y a la muerte un criado a quien estimaba mucho.

verse.en: And it came to pass afterwards that he went into a city that is called Naim: and there went with him his disciples and a great multitude.
verse.web: Soon afterwards, he went to a city called Nain. Many of his disciples, along with a great multitude, went with him.
verse.es: Sucedió después, que iba Jesús camino de la ciudad llamada Naim; y con él iban sus discípulos, y mucho gentío.

celebration.en: Saints Andrew Kim Tae-gŏn, Priest, and Paul Chŏng Ha-sang, and Companions, Martyrs
celebration.es: Santos Andrés Kim Tae-gŏn, presbítero, Pablo Chŏng Ha-sang y compañeros, mártires

verse.en: And the Lord said: Whereunto then shall I liken the men of this generation? And to what are they like?
verse.web: “To what then should I compare the people of this generation? What are they like? They are like children who sit in the marketplace and call to one another, saying, ‘We piped to you, and you didn’t dance.
verse.es: Ahora bien, concluyó el Señor: ¿A quién diré que es semejante esta raza de hombres? y ¿a quién se parecen?

verse.en: And when Jesus passed on from thence, he saw a man sitting in the custom house, named Matthew; and he saith to him: Follow me. And he arose up and followed him.
verse.web: As Jesus passed by from there, he saw a man called Matthew sitting at the tax collection office. He said to him, “Follow me.” He got up and followed him.
verse.es: Partido de aquí Jesús, vio a un hombre sentado al banco o mesa de las alcabalas, llamado Matheo. Y le dijo: Sígueme. Y él levantándose luego, le siguió.

verse.en: And it came to pass afterwards, that he travelled through the cities and towns, preaching and evangelizing the kingdom of God: and the twelve with him…
verse.web: Soon afterwards, he went about through cities and villages, preaching and bringing the good news of God’s Kingdom.
verse.es: Algún tiempo después andaba Jesús por las ciudades y aldeas predicando, y anunciando el reino de Dios, acompañado de los doce, y de algunas mugeres, que habían sido libradas de los espíritus malignos…

verse.en: And when a very great multitude was gathered together and hastened out of the cities, unto him, he spoke by a similitude. The sower went out to sow his seed. And as he sowed, some fell by the way side.
verse.web: When a great multitude came together and people from every city were coming to him, he spoke by a parable: “The farmer went out to sow his seed.
verse.es: En ocasión de un grandísimo concurso de gentes, que de las ciudades acudían presurosas a él, dijo esta parábola: Salió un sembrador a sembrar su simiente; y al esparcirla, parte cayó a lo largo del camino…

verse.en: And he said also to his disciples: There was a certain rich man who had a steward: and the same was accused unto him, that he had wasted his goods. And he called him and said to him: How is it that I hear this of thee?
verse.web: He also said to his disciples, “There was a certain rich man who had a manager. An accusation was made to him that this man was wasting his possessions.
verse.es: Decía también Jesús a sus discípulos: Érase un hombre rico, que tenía un mayordomo, del cual por la voz común vino a entender que le había disipado sus bienes. Llamole pues, y díjole: ¿Qué es esto que oigo de ti?

verse.en: Now no man lighting a candle covereth it with a vessel or putteth it under a bed: but setteth it upon a candlestick, that they who come in may see the light.
verse.web: “No one, when he has lit a lamp, covers it with a container or puts it under a bed; but puts it on a stand, that those who enter in may see the light.
verse.es: Y añadió: Ninguno después de encender una antorcha la tapa con una vasija, ni la mete debajo de la cama; sino que la pone sobre un candelero, para que dé luz a los que entran.

verse.en: And his mother and brethren came unto him: and they could not come at him for the crowd. And it was told him: Thy mother and thy brethren stand without, desiring to see thee.
verse.web: His mother and brothers came to him, and they could not come near him for the crowd. Some people told him, “Your mother and your brothers stand outside, desiring to see you.”
verse.es: Entre tanto vinieron a encontrarle su madre y primos hermanos, y no pudiendo acercarse a él a causa del gentío, se lo avisaron, diciéndole: Tu madre y tus hermanos están allá fuera, que te quieren ver.

verse.en: Then calling together the twelve apostles, he gave them power and authority over all devils and to cure diseases. And he sent them to preach the kingdom of God and to heal the sick.
verse.web: He called the twelve together and gave them power and authority over all demons, and to cure diseases. He sent them out to preach God’s Kingdom and to heal the sick.
verse.es: Algún tiempo después habiendo convocado a los doce apóstoles, les dio poder, y autoridad sobre todos los demonios, y virtud de curar enfermedades. Y enviolos a predicar el reino de Dios, y a dar la salud a los enfermos.

verse.en: Now Herod, the tetrarch, heard of all things that were done by him.
verse.web: Now Herod the tetrarch heard of all that was done by him; and he was very perplexed, because it was said by some that John had risen from the dead, and by some that Elijah had appeared…
verse.es: Entre tanto oyó Herodes el tetrarchâ, todo lo que hacía Jesús, y no sabía a qué atenerse, porque unos decían: Sin duda que Juan ha resucitado: algunos: No, sino que ha aparecido Elías: otros, en fin…

celebration.en: Saints Michael, Gabriel and Raphael, Archangels
celebration.es: Santos arcángeles Miguel, Gabriel y Rafael

verse.en: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him and he saith of him: Behold an Israelite indeed, in whom there is no guile. Nathanael saith to him: Whence knowest thou me?
verse.web: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and said about him, “Behold, an Israelite indeed, in whom is no deceit!” Nathanael said to him, “How do you know me?”
verse.es: Vio Jesús venir acia sí a Nathanael, y dijo de él: He aquí un verdadero israelita, en quien no hay doblez ni engaño. Dícele Nathanael: ¿De dónde me conoces?

celebration.en: Saint Jerome, Priest and Doctor of the Church
celebration.es: San Jerónimo, presbítero y doctor de la Iglesia

verse.en: And all were astonished at the mighty power of God.
verse.web: They were all astonished at the majesty of God.
verse.es: Con lo que todos quedaban pasmados del gran poder de Dios que brillaba en Jesús; y mientras que todo el mundo no cesaba de admirar las cosas que hacía, él dijo a sus discípulos…

verse.en: There was a certain rich man who was clothed in purple and fine linen and feasted sumptuously every day.
verse.web: “Now there was a certain rich man, and he was clothed in purple and fine linen, living in luxury every day.
verse.es: Hubo cierto hombre muy rico, que se vestía de púrpura y de lino finísimo, y tenía cada día espléndidos banquetes.

verse.en: At that hour the disciples came to Jesus, saying: Who, thinkest thou, is the greater in the kingdom of heaven? And Jesus, calling unto him a little child, set him in the midst of them.
verse.web: In that hour the disciples came to Jesus, saying, “Who then is greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven?”
verse.es: En esta misma ocasión se acercaron los discípulos a Jesús, y le hicieron esta pregunta: ¿Quién será el mayor en el reino de los cielos?

verse.en: And it came to pass, when the days of his assumption were accomplishing, that he steadfastly set his face to go to Jerusalem.
verse.web: It came to pass, when the days were near that he should be taken up, he intently set his face to go to Jerusalem and sent messengers before his face.
verse.es: Y cuando estaba para cumplirse el tiempo en que Jesús había de salir del mundo, se puso en camino, mostrando un semblante decidido para ir a Jerusalem, a consumar su sacrificio.

verse.en: And it came to pass, as they walked in the way, that a certain man said to him: I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest.
verse.web: As they went on the way, a certain man said to him, “I want to follow you wherever you go, Lord.”
verse.es: Mientras iban andando su camino, hubo un hombre que le dijo: Señor, yo te seguiré a donde quiera que fueres.

verse.en: And after these things, the Lord appointed also other seventy-two. And he sent them two and two before his face into every city and place whither he himself was to come.
verse.web: Now after these things, the Lord also appointed seventy others, and sent them two by two ahead of him into every city and place where he was about to come.
verse.es: Después de esto eligió el Señor otros setenta y dos discípulos, a los cuales envió delante de él, de dos en dos, por todas las ciudades, y lugares a donde había de venir él mismo.

verse.en: Woe to thee, Corozain! Woe to thee, Bethsaida! For if in Tyre and Sidon had been wrought the mighty works that have been wrought in you, they would have done penance long ago, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.
verse.web: “Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon which were done in you, they would have repented long ago, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.
verse.es: ¡Ay de ti, Corozain! ¡ay de ti, Bethsaida!

verse.en: And the seventy-two returned with joy, saying: Lord, the devils also are subject to us in thy name. And he said to them: I saw Satan like lightning falling from heaven.
verse.web: The seventy returned with joy, saying, “Lord, even the demons are subject to us in your name!” He said to them, “I saw Satan having fallen like lightning from heaven.
verse.es: Regresaron después los setenta y dos discípulos llenos de gozo, diciendo: Señor, hasta los demonios mismos se sujetan a nosotros por la virtud de tu nombre.

verse.en: And the apostles said to the Lord: Increase our faith. And the Lord said: If you had faith like to a grain of mustard seed, you might say to this mulberry tree: Be thou rooted up and be thou transplanted into the sea.
verse.web: The apostles said to the Lord, “Increase our faith.” The Lord said, “If you had faith like a grain of mustard seed, you would tell this sycamore tree, ‘Be uprooted and be planted in the sea,’ and it would obey you.
verse.es: Entonces los apóstoles dijeron al Señor: Auméntanos la fe. Y el Señor les dijo: Si tuviereis fe tan grande como un granito de mostaza, diréis a ese moral: Arráncate de raíz, y trasplántate en el mar; y os obedecerá.

verse.en: And behold a certain lawyer stood up, tempting him and saying, Master, what must I do to possess eternal life? But he said to him: What is written in the law? How readest thou?
verse.web: Behold, a certain lawyer stood up and tested him, saying, “Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?” He said to him, “What is written in the law? How do you read it?”
verse.es: Levantose entonces un doctor de la Ley, y díjole con el fin de tentarle: Maestro, ¿qué debo yo hacer para conseguir la vida eterna? Díjole Jesús: ¿Qué es lo que se halla escrito en la Ley? ¿qué es lo que en ella lees?

verse.en: Now it came to pass, as they went, that he entered into a certain town: and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house.
verse.web: As they went on their way, he entered into a certain village, and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house. She had a sister called Mary, who also sat at Jesus’ feet and heard his word.
verse.es: Prosiguiendo Jesús su viage a Jerusalem, entró en cierta aldea, donde una muger, por nombre Martha, le hospedó en su casa: tenía esta una hermana llamada María…

verse.en: And it came to pass that as he was in a certain place praying, when he ceased, one of his disciples said to him: Lord, teach us to pray, as John also taught his disciples.
verse.web: When he finished praying in a certain place, one of his disciples said to him, “Lord, teach us to pray, just as John also taught his disciples.”
verse.es: Un día estando Jesús orando en cierto lugar, acabada la oración, díjole uno de sus discípulos: Señor, enséñanos a orar, como enseñó también Juan a sus discípulos.

verse.en: And he said to them: Which of you shall have a friend and shall go to him at midnight and shall say to him: Friend, lend me three loaves…
verse.web: He said to them, “Which of you, if you go to a friend at midnight and tell him, ‘Friend, lend me three loaves of bread, for a friend of mine has come to me from a journey, and I have nothing to set before him…
verse.es: Díjole también: Si alguno de vosotros tuviere un amigo, y fuese a estar con él a media noche, y a decirle: Amigo, préstame tres panes, porque otro amigo mío acaba de llegar de viage a mi casa, y no tengo nada que darle…

verse.en: But some of them said: He casteth out devils by Beelzebub, the prince of devils. And others tempting, asked of him a sign from heaven.
verse.web: But some of them said, “He casts out demons by Beelzebul, the prince of the demons.” Others, testing him, sought from him a sign from heaven.
